evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# Node Canvas — a ComfyUI-shaped infinite canvas for DeepSeek Harness

A DSH client plugin: an infinite node canvas in the sidebar. Nodes, ports and workflows are
ComfyUI-shaped, but the runtime is our own Node executor — and a running ComfyUI can be used as a
remote execution backend when you need its node pack.

## What it does

- **Infinite canvas**: create nodes, wire ports, marquee/zoom/pan, groups, undo, minimap.
- **Node packs**: a pack is a folder with `pack.json` (node definitions) and `nodes/<Type>.mjs`
  (programs). A workflow stores types and widget values only — definitions and programs always
  come from the installed packs.
- **Workflows**: save / save as / export / rename / delete, plus a status pill that tells whether
  the canvas still equals its saved copy. A workflow opened from a backend's list lives on that
  backend: saving writes the backend's own file and keeps no local copy, so the two libraries
  never drift apart. Save as creates the new file on the backend and the canvas follows its name.
- **Extensions**: capability packages that enhance the plugin (workflow formats, node views,
  toolbar actions, panels, hover cards, execution backends). Drag a folder into the puzzle menu to
  register one; order them by dragging, top wins. See [extensions/README.md](extensions/README.md).
- **Extension settings**: the gear under the puzzle menu's plus opens a settings window with an
  index of extensions on the left and the selected form on the right. A package declares its
  fields in its own `extension.json` (values only the user knows, such as the ComfyUI folder and
  its Python); the canvas writes them into that package's `settings.json`. Path fields get a
  browse button (the canvas' own folder browser when the desktop app has no native picker), and
  a package may attach `validate` rules that the form checks before saving.

## Install

The plugin is linked into a DSH profile as a local package:

```json
// ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json
{ "dependencies": { "@local/node-canvas": "link:D:/path/to/node-canvas" } }
```

Then enable the plugin row `include:node-canvas` in that profile.

## Configure

```bash
cp config.example.json config.json
```

| Key | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `sdCppRoot` | sd.cpp checkout (its `bin/sd-server.exe` and `models/` are used by the sd.cpp pack) |
| `sdCppPort` | port the plugin starts `sd-server` on |
| `outputDir` | folder the previews read finished images from |
| `workspaceRoot` | scratch root for per-run directories (empty = `.workspace/` beside the plugin) |
| `sdServerArgs` | extra flags for `sd-server`, e.g. `["--vae-tiling"]` |

The ComfyUI extension has its own [settings](extensions/comfyui/settings.example.json) (service
path, python, URL). Copy it to `extensions/comfyui/settings.json` when you use that backend.

## Layout

```
client.js      canvas UI (single bundle, no JSX)
index.js       host: packs, workflows, output files, extension routes
executor.js    generic executor: graph → programs, locks, per-run workspace
packs/         node packs
extensions/    capability packages (a ComfyUI format adapter + backend, a hover card)
workflows/     saved workflows (v2: types + values, no definitions)
locale/        plugin name/description shown by the harness
```

## Reference frame

The panel has exactly one coordinate system: the page rect. The canvas is an infinite plane
(`view.x`, `view.y`, `zoom`) of which the shell shows one region; nothing else stores a position.

The rules that keep it that way:

- **No measured size in state.** Anything that needs the canvas area calls `shellSize()` and uses
  the rectangle the shell has at that moment. The resize observer reports only a boolean crossing
  (too small for the overview) and keeps the overview's box in sync imperatively.
- **Derived geometry lives in CSS.** The library menu publishes `--nc-menu-top`, `-w` and `-split`
  on the page; the band under it and both drag handles are `calc()` of those, so a window resize
  never reaches JavaScript. A drag writes the variable directly and re-renders only on release.
- **Chrome that must not move cancels the transform it rides.** During the fullscreen slide the
  page translates by `pageShift`; the overview cancels it with the same value and the same
  transition, so it stays put on screen without a second reference frame.

Known limitation: the canvas is fixed in the window, so moving the window (title bar, or dragging
its left/top edge) takes the canvas with it. Making the canvas stay put on screen instead needs the
window's real screen geometry, and the renderer only sees `screenX`/`screenY`, which the host does
not report reliably while an edge is being dragged. Two attempts are recorded in git: a fixed
window-space canvas with a `clip-path` (`window-canvas-attempt`) and a dual-corner compensation
driven by `screenX`. Both were reverted; the feature waits for the host to expose trustworthy
window bounds.
- **The fullscreen sheet is measured against the viewport** when the panel is flush with the
  window's right and bottom edges (`width: 100%`, `height: calc(100vh - top)`), so dragging a
  window edge follows immediately instead of waiting for a new measurement.
- **The brand button is a window-state switch.** Its lit state is the measured distance from the
  canvas slot's left edge to the window (`< 32px` means the canvas owns the window), never the
  sheet's own state. Pressing it runs two steps in order: grow the sheet to fullscreen and then put
  the host sidebar away, or bring the sidebar back and only then shrink the sheet into the room it
  actually leaves. The second step waits for the sidebar's animation to settle, so the distance the
  sheet travels is always the one that exists at that moment.

## License

No license file yet — add one before publishing if you intend others to reuse it.

# dsh-kbar

DSH 的命令面板。按 `Ctrl+Shift+P`（macOS `Cmd+Shift+P`）打开，输入关键字，回车执行。

## 能做什么

| 输入 | 结果 | 回车后 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 会话标题里的词 | 匹配的会话 | 打开该会话 |
| `flash`、`pro` | 当前会话可用的模型 | 切换模型 |
| 插件名的一部分 | 已安装的插件 | 打开插件详情页 |
| 技能名的一部分 | 当前工作区的技能 | 复制 `/技能名` |
| `新建`、`插件` | 内置动作 | 新建会话 / 打开插件页 |
| 命令名的一部分 | DSH 快捷键命令 | 执行该命令 |

`↑`/`↓` 选择，`Enter` 执行，`Esc` 关闭；右上角 `×` 也能关。

面板顶部有一条拖动栏：按住可以移动，双击回到居中位置，位置会记住。

除了快捷键，侧边栏底部也有「打开命令面板」入口，点一下就开。

`Ctrl+K` 是 DSH 自带的会话搜索，所以这里用 `Ctrl+Shift+P`。想换键位：设置 → 快捷键。

## 安装

```sh
# npm
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-kbar

# GitHub
dsh plugin --profile web add "git+https://github.com/adengou/dsh-kbar.git"

# Gitee
dsh plugin --profile web add "git+https://gitee.com/adengou/dsh-kbar.git"
```

DSH 桌面版在 设置 → 插件 里安装。

## 许可

MIT License，版权归 adengou。完整文本见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

# AdsPilot

**开源、免费。** 把整套广告联盟投放能力做成基座加插件，交给你自己的 Agent（Claude Code、Codex、OpenClaw、Hermes 或同类），在你自己的账号、你自己的机器上无人值守地跑。不登录、不托管、不收费。

**合规姿态，与开源免费并排写在第一屏。** 本人真实身份、单账号，平台要 KYC 照实做；不造流量、不模拟点击、不做 cloaking、不绕平台资格与封禁、不冒充身份、不做多账号；凭据零留存，一切在你自己的机器与账号里。做不到这几条的，这个仓库帮不上。

*English: [README.en.md](README.en.md)*

## 这是什么，为什么这么做

传统的投放 SaaS 是「平台替你干活」：你登录它的后台，把账号托管给它，按月付费，它替你建广告、看报表、调预算。这个架构下登录、计费、多租户、托管 token 一样都少不了，而且它永远在替你做判断，你看不见它怎么判的。

AdsPilot 反过来，是「你的 Agent 替你干活」。仓库里没有一个要编译的程序、没有后台、没有账号系统。它是一套写给 Agent 看的使用方法，加一组只用 Python 标准库的小脚本。使用方法用 iLang 写，所以 Claude Code、Codex 或别的 Agent 读到的是同一份，执行出来也是同一个样子。你的 Agent 读完入口文件，先自检这台机器够不够格，然后按使用方法在你自己的 Google Ads 和 CJ 账号上建广告、拉报表、对账、把转化灌回去，每天自己跑一轮。

它分两块，一条判据切开：**凡是要对外部 API 说话的，就是插件；剩下的全是主干。** 主干不依赖任何一家外部服务，任何一个插件消失，主干照样跑，只是笨一点。加一家平台或一家联盟，只加一个目录，主干一行不改。

能跑起来是主干保证的；跑得好不好取决于 SOUL。SOUL 是所有判断规则和阈值的集合，仓库自带一个通用默认 SOUL，本地、开源、零成本。每到要做决定的地方（选哪个 offer、要不要上线、今天加预算还是暂停、这个词要不要停、转化要不要灌、账号异常要不要停），主干把状态打成 iLang v5 的 11 维向量，按冻结的 f_v5 算出 M1 到 M8。判断给的是建议，不是闸门：你明确说了要投什么、要怎么调，就照你的做，判断照算，作为建议写进输出和账本；你没说，Agent 才按判断自己拿主意，M1 和 M2 执行，其余只提议。唯一不因一句话放行的是第一屏那几条合规姿态。公益期 iLang Inc. 托管一个判断服务（便宜模型加 Jev），免费给大家用，用真实数据把判断磨准。这也是 iLang 协议第一个较大的商用应用：v3 通信层、v4 执行层、v5 判断层各管一段。

人只在三处出现：证件与 KYC、付款与绑卡、平台要求本人申诉。其余全是 Agent 与脚本。

## 一个学员的一天

早上六点半，调度器把 `core/loop/daily.py` 拉起来。它先自检，再从自有域名的中转拉回昨天的点击映射，读 Google Ads 的报表，拉 CJ 的佣金明细，把佣金按 token 对回 gclid 和关键词，生成能直接灌回 Google Ads 的转化文件。然后逐个系列、逐个词过一遍判断：这条系列均价超了就降价，那条连花一百块没转化就暂停，这条谷歌推荐了新预算就照推荐改。判断出来的动作，凭据齐的话通过 API 直接做掉，转化通过 Data Manager 传上去；凭据不齐就写成一张清单，Agent 在后台照着做。最后在 `runs/<id>/` 留一份 `report.json` 和 `run.log`，退出码 0 是正常，2 是要本人出手，教练要看就把这两个文件贴过去。没有任何东西自动往外发。

## 骨架一眼看

```
core/         主干：agent 适配与 MCP · launch 开局 · lp 落地页 · judge 判断（f_v5 冻结）与评测/校准 · ledger 归因对账 · loop 无人值守循环与哨兵 · selfcheck 与 preflight 总检
plugins/      插件：traffic/google-ads（含 oauth_helper） · affiliate/{cj,impact} · judgment/{llm,jev,soul-api,_template} · deploy/cloudflare · keywords · ipintel
skills/       DSH 运行时技能定义（sem，触发词 SEM / 付费投流）
BOOK.md       iLang v5 工程书（M0_SETUP 到 M5_REPORT，由 adspilot_book 分段读取）
integrations/ 宿主接入：DSH Cordis 插件入口（index.mjs）、MCP 模板、handoff 与测试
soul/         默认 SOUL、SOUL 接口、SOUL API 接口说明
schemas/      manifest · judgment · report · traffic-spec · traffic-report · commissions · 39 项接口 schema
reference/    iLang runtime 与语法校验器（钉版本） · affiliate-design · v1 交接
```

架构总图在 `ARCHITECTURE.md`，一页纸，改它要老板点头。

## 走到哪了

截至 2026-11-20，版本 2.2.1。下面每一块都有代码、有使用方法、有自测，区别只在有没有碰过真实世界。

| 部件 | 状态 | 真实世界 |
|---|---|---|
| Agent 适配与能力自检 | 完成 | 三份入口正文一致，十四项自检（快速模式十二项），iLang runtime 钉版本校验；Windows 11 与 Linux 自测全过 |
| OAuth 双作用域助手与上线前总检 | 完成 | `oauth_helper.py`（PKCE 一次性获取 `adwords` + `datamanager`）与 `preflight.py`（币种、scope、落地位鉴权）通过离线及本地回环自测；实盘需用户账号 |
| 开局（三把钥匙进，一条系列出） | **真实账号实测通过** | 在 reviews.aixray.dev 从零建落地位、发页、建系列、真点一次进账本，全程无人，然后拆净（2.0.9 历史记录） |
| 落地页 | 完成 | 模板与合规检查通过自测，开局时在真域名上发过一页 |
| 判断（f_v5 冻结）与 L2 评测 | 完成 | 判断块用 iLang 正典校验器核过；`provider_chain` 回退、`eval_provider.py` L2 门槛评测与动态边界检查通过离线自测 |
| 归因与对账 | 完成 | 增加 `schema_version=1`、已上传转化游标、拒付对账与拉取截断保护；跑过样例与游标回归自测 |
| 无人值守循环与哨兵 | 完成 | 外部写统一收口至双开关门控（显式 `--apply` 且配置布尔 `true`），随附 cron/systemd/Windows 调度模板默认显式 `--dry-run`，支持 `retry_later`、7 天模拟验收与哨兵脱敏告警；真实七天待学员环境 |
| 默认 SOUL | 完成 | 金额按美元定义、按账户币种折算；出价与预算照谷歌推荐；出价方式默认尽可能多点击；自定义边界由代码强制执行；阈值校准仍待真实数据 |

| 选品第一条（词的出价 < 每次点击赚的钱） | **真实账号实测通过** | CJ 前 10 家查词算账，3 家过、7 家出局，过线的词直接带给建系列 |
| 插件 关键词（Google Ads Keyword Planner） | **真实账号实测通过** | 用商家首页当种子出品类词，带月搜索与首页出价 |
| DSH 3.1 插件包、工程书与交接 | 完成 | 同仓提供 npm `adspilot` 组合包、`BOOK.md`、`sem` 技能（触发 `SEM` / `付费投流`）、`adspilot_book` 分页工具与 `dsh.handoff`；16 项 Node 测试与严格 iLang 校验全过 |
| 统一 JSON 接口与 MCP | 完成 | 39 个接口与 `daily.py` 共用集中式双开关写门控（`write_gate.py`），137 项真值表与跨通道隔离回归自测全过 |

## 三分钟上手（给你的 Agent）

```bash
git clone https://github.com/adsorgcn/AdsPilot && cd AdsPilot
python3 core/agent/selfcheck.py                       # 够不够格无人值守
cp config/adspilot.example.json config/adspilot.json  # 填自己的值，凭据放环境变量或 DSH 3.1 账本
python3 core/selfcheck/preflight.py                   # 上线前总检（加 --apply 实测账户币种、scope 与落地位）
python3 core/loop/daily.py --dry-run                  # 跑一轮，什么都不写外部
```

Claude Code 读 `CLAUDE.md`，Codex 与其他读 `AGENTS.md`，Cursor 读 `.cursor/rules/`（三份正文一致、各自保留抬头）。在 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）里也可直接加载 `adspilot` 插件包并说「SEM」或「付费投流」，按工程书 `BOOK.md` 从装机走到日循环；之后按 `core/loop/使用方法.md` 装调度器，每天一轮。

## 版本与许可

`VERSION` 三位号。日常改动只动末位；「迭代小版本」动中间位；大版本第一位单独决定。每一版的细节在 `CHANGELOG.md`。

MIT。iLang runtime 副本来自 ilang-spec（MIT）。

# dsh-checkin-all

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-checkin-all?style=flat-square&logo=npm&color=cb3837)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-checkin-all)
[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-checkin-all?style=flat-square&color=blue)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-checkin-all)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-checkin-all?style=flat-square&color=green)](./LICENSE)
[![node](https://img.shields.io/node/v/dsh-checkin-all?style=flat-square&logo=node.js)](https://nodejs.org)
[![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-%E2%89%A50.2.0-4B32C3?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh)
[![tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/tests-183%20passing-brightgreen?style=flat-square)](./test)
[![services](https://img.shields.io/badge/%E5%86%85%E7%BD%AE%E6%9C%8D%E5%8A%A1-11-2f6bff?style=flat-square)](#支持的服务)

**签到 / 自动签到 / 每日签到 / 打卡 / 领积分 / 多账号 / DIY 自定义签到 / DeepSeek Harness 插件**

每天自动给 **MiniMax Code**、**WPS 灵犀**、**百度 DuMate（搭子）**、**AStudio（星火）**、**Qoder**、**Trae**、**豆包**、**华为 CodeArts**、**腾讯 WorkBuddy**、**商汤小浣熊**、**天翼 AI（TeleAgent）** 签到领积分。

**没在列表里的服务，可以自己 DIY 签到**——面板点「＋ 添加签到服务」，让 DSH 的 AI 帮你查接口，或直接贴一份 JSON，导入就变成新卡片。

**每个服务都支持多账号**：同一个服务配多个号，逐个签、分别记账，一个失败不影响其他。

装进 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh)（dsh）之后，它会用本机 App 已经存好的登录凭据，每天到点调一次官方签到接口，签完记账，面板挂在对话页右侧栏。

> 你不用记着签，也不用把账号密码交给任何东西——凭据本来就是 App 自己存的（MiniMax Code 在 `~/.minimax/auth/`，灵犀和搭子在各自的 Cookies 里）。

> **为什么要自动签**：灵犀的连续签到断一天就归零（回退到第 1 天）。手动记着签太容易忘，这个插件就是替你记住的那一下。

## 三个重点能力

### 1. 内置 11 个服务，开箱即用

装上就能签，凭据自动从本机 App 里读，不用手动配。详见下方「支持的服务」。

### 2. 没有的服务？自己 DIY 一个

内置之外还有一堆能签到的站点。面板底部有 **「＋ 添加签到服务」**，两条路：

**让 DSH 的 AI 帮你做**（推荐）

```
点「＋ 添加签到服务」→ 复制提示词 → 粘到 DSH 对话
→ 告诉 AI 是哪个 App / 网站、本机哪里登录着
→ AI 帮你查接口，给一段 JSON
→ 回来「粘贴定义」贴进去 → 立刻多一张卡片
```

**自己写定义**（知道接口长什么样的话）

一份 JSON 描述接口就行，不用改代码：

```json
{
  "id": "kuaKe",
  "name": "夸克网盘",
  "short": "夸克",
  "color": "#0ea5e9",
  "unit": "积分",
  "checkin": { "method": "POST", "url": "https://example.com/api/checkin",
               "headers": { "cookie": "{{cookie}}" } },
  "status":  { "url": "https://example.com/api/status",
               "claimedPath": "data.checked_in_today",
               "pointsPath": "data.today_points" },
  "successPath": "code",
  "successValue": 0
}
```

导入后它和内置服务**完全一样**：参与自动签到、有卡片、能记账、支持多账号。

> 限制：只覆盖「一个 HTTP 请求 + 一个状态查询」这种形态。需要签名（如华为云 HMAC）或多步流程的服务，还是得写代码。

### 3. 每个服务支持多账号

同一个服务可以配多个账号，签到时会逐个签、分别汇报。

```
面板「账号」卡片 → 填凭据 → 添加账号（可加备注名区分主号 / 小号）
```

命令行也行：

```bash
node bin/dsh-checkin-all.js set lingxi "<sid>" --name 主号
node bin/dsh-checkin-all.js set lingxi "<sid>" --name 小号
```

汇总规则：任一账号签上就算成功，积分累加，连续天数取最大值；单个账号失败不影响其他账号，消息里会点名是哪个失败。

支持多账号的：灵犀、DuMate、AStudio、Qoder、Trae、豆包、CodeArts、WorkBuddy，以及**所有 DIY 的自定义服务**。
（MiniMax 例外：凭据是 App 的 OAuth 文件且 refresh token 一次性，不适合多账号。）

## 支持的服务

| 服务 | 凭据来源 | 签到单位 | 多账号 | 「今天」按哪算 |
| --- | --- | --- | :---: | --- |
| MiniMax Code | `~/.minimax/auth/`（OAuth） | 分 | — | **北京时间** |
| WPS 灵犀 | 灵犀自己的 Cookies（`wps_sid`） | 智点 | ✅ | **北京时间** |
| 百度 DuMate | `qianfan-desktop-app/auth.json`（加密 cookie） | 积分 | ✅ | **北京时间** |
| AStudio | `~/.acode/acode/userdata/astron-session.json` | 积分 | ✅ | **北京时间** |
| Qoder | 本机 Qoder App 登录（自动读），或面板填 PAT | 积分 | ✅ | **北京时间** |
| Trae | 本机 Trae App/CLI 登录（自动读） | 积分 | ✅ | **北京时间** |
| 豆包 | 登录 Cookie（面板「配置 Cookie」，或从本机豆包/浏览器读） | 额度 | ✅ | **北京时间** |
| 华为 CodeArts | 浏览器登录（点一下授权，自动拿 AK/SK；也可手填） | 积分 | ✅ | **北京时间** |
| 腾讯 WorkBuddy | 浏览器登录（点一下授权；也可手贴 token） | 积分 | ✅ | **北京时间** |
| 商汤小浣熊 | 点「登录」弹一个独立浏览器窗口，自己登录即自动取 token（也可手贴 Cookie） | 积分 | ✅ | **北京时间** |
| 天翼 AI（TeleAgent） | 点「登录」弹一个独立浏览器窗口，自己登录即自动取 token（也可手贴 operationToken） | 积分 | ✅ | **北京时间** |
| **自定义服务** | 面板「添加签到服务」，AI 生成或自己贴 JSON | 自定义 | ✅ | **北京时间** |

**全部服务一律按北京时间算「今天」和签到窗口，不跟随本机时区。**

（早期版本里 MiniMax 跟本机时区，结果美西晚上 8 点之后本机还是 4 号、北京已经是 5 号，
两条口径对不上，会出现重复签和连续天数错乱。现在统一成北京时间，本机在哪都一样。）

## 它做什么

- **每个服务每天到点自动签到**：默认 09:00，可给每个服务单独设时间
- **多账号**：同一个服务能配多个账号，逐个签、分别汇报，一个失败不影响其他
- **自定义服务**：面板「＋ 添加签到服务」，让 AI 查接口或自己贴 JSON，导入即成卡片
- **紧凑卡片**：每张卡两行——彩色服务名 + 连续天数 / 登录状态 + 今日签到
- **折叠**：未登录、无任务、还没到轮次的自动收起来，点一下展开
- **拖动排序**：拖卡片换位置，顺序记在本机
- **补签**：电脑睡过了、DSH 半夜才启动，醒来照样补上（可关）
- **不重复签**：今天已经签过（哪怕你是在 App 里点的）就不动
- **失败退避**：连续失败会拉长重试间隔（1/2/4/8/16/32 分钟），失败 6 次当天停手，不会白刷接口
- **自动续期**：access token 快过期时用 refresh token 换新的并**写回 App 的位置**，App 那边不受影响
- **记账**：每个服务分开记连续天数、累计积分、最近 14 天每天的结果
- **对话里能用**：说「帮我签到」「MiniMax 积分还有多少」「以后每天 8 点签」就行
- **登录兜底**：凭据失效时给一个设备码或浏览器授权（CodeArts / WorkBuddy），点一下就好

## 安装

```bash
# 从 npm（推荐）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-checkin-all

# 或者从仓库
git clone https://github.com/AIcivilization/dsh-checkin-all.git
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /path/to/dsh-checkin-all
```

完全退出 DSH（macOS 按 Cmd+Q，不是关窗口）再重新打开。

装好后打开对话页右侧栏，引导页里点「自动签到」；或者「设置 → 自动签到」。

## 命令行

不开 DSH 也能用：

```bash
node bin/dsh-checkin-all.js status          # 每个服务：登录状态 + 本周签到表 + 连续天数
node bin/dsh-checkin-all.js checkin         # 全部签到（--dry 只看不领）
node bin/dsh-checkin-all.js checkin lingxi  # 只签灵犀（或 minimax / dumate / astudio / qoder / trae / doubao）
node bin/dsh-checkin-all.js login           # 设备码登录 MiniMax Code
node bin/dsh-checkin-all.js time 08:30      # 改自动签到时间
node bin/dsh-checkin-all.js on | off        # 开 / 关自动签到
```

### 手动配置凭据（VPS 等没有 App 的机器）

灵犀、搭子、AStudio、Trae 默认读本机 App 的登录文件；在 VPS 上或没有装对应 App 时，
可以手动配置凭据（存 `~/.dsh/dsh-checkin-all/secrets.json`，0600）：

```bash
node bin/dsh-checkin-all.js set lingxi  "<wps_sid>"
node bin/dsh-checkin-all.js set dumate  "<完整 Cookie 串，含 bce-user-info>"
node bin/dsh-checkin-all.js set astudio "<accountId>,<token>,<ssoSessionId>"
node bin/dsh-checkin-all.js set trae    "<Cloud-IDE-JWT token>"
node bin/dsh-checkin-all.js set codearts "<access_key_id>,<secret_access_key>,<security_token>"

node bin/dsh-checkin-all.js unset lingxi   # 删除某个服务的手动凭据，回退到 App 文件
```

手动配置优先于 App 文件；删掉手动凭据后自动回退读 App。

也可以在面板里操作：打开对话页右侧栏「自动签到」，切到对应服务卡，点「配置凭据」，粘贴值保存即可（清除后回退 App 文件）。

### 不依赖 DSH 常驻：挂到系统 crontab

```cron
0 9 * * * /usr/local/bin/node /Users/wf/dsh/dsh-checkin-all/bin/dsh-checkin-all.js cron >> ~/.dsh/dsh-checkin-all/cron.log 2>&1
```

`cron` 是静默模式：今天签过了就什么都不做，只在真签的时候输出一行。

> 注意：cron 的时间是**本机时区**，但插件判断「今天」和签到窗口是**北京时间**。
> 本机在美国时，想在北京时间 09:00 签，cron 要写成本机对应的时刻（美西 = 前一天 17:00）。

## 在对话里

| 你说 | 会发生什么 |
| --- | --- |
| 帮我签到 / 领一下积分 | 调 `minimax_checkin`，三个服务都签（也可只签一个） |
| 灵犀连续多少天了 / 签到情况 | 调 `minimax_checkin_status`，给每个服务的一周表、连续天数 |
| 以后每天 8 点自动签 | 调 `minimax_checkin_config`，改时间（可只改一个服务） |
| MiniMax 登录失效了 | 调 `minimax_login`，给设备码和网址 |

命令：`/checkin 状态｜签到 [服务]｜时间 09:00｜开启｜关闭｜登录`（`/minimax` 是别名）

服务名：`minimax`（MiniMax Code）/ `lingxi`（WPS 灵犀）/ `dumate`（百度 DuMate）/ `astudio`（AStudio）/ `qoder`（Qoder）/ `trae`（Trae）/ `doubao`（豆包）/ `codearts`（华为 CodeArts）/ `buddy`（腾讯 WorkBuddy）/ `xiaohuanxiong`（商汤小浣熊）/ `teleagent`（天翼 AI）

## 加新的签到服务（不写代码）

内置 11 个服务，但外面还有一堆能签到的站点。面板底部有个 **「＋ 添加签到服务」**，
点开有两条路：

### 方式一：让 DSH 的 AI 帮你做（推荐）

1. 点「添加签到服务」→ 复制那段提示词
2. 粘到 DSH 对话里，告诉 AI 是哪个 App / 网站、本机哪里登录着
3. AI 帮你查接口，最后给一段 JSON
4. 回来切到「粘贴定义」，把 JSON 整段贴进去 → 导入

导入后**立刻变成一张新卡片**，和内置服务一样参与自动签到。

### 方式二：自己写定义

如果你已经知道接口长什么样，直接粘这份 JSON：

```json
{
  "id": "kuaKe",
  "name": "夸克网盘",
  "short": "夸克",
  "color": "#0ea5e9",
  "unit": "积分",
  "checkin": {
    "method": "POST",
    "url": "https://example.com/api/checkin",
    "headers": { "referer": "https://example.com/", "cookie": "{{cookie}}" },
    "body": { "type": "daily" }
  },
  "status": {
    "method": "GET",
    "url": "https://example.com/api/status",
    "claimedPath": "data.checked_in_today",
    "pointsPath": "data.today_points"
  },
  "successPath": "code",
  "successValue": 0,
  "alreadyPath": "data.already",
  "messagePath": "message"
}
```

字段说明：

| 字段 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `id` | 唯一标识，字母开头，字母数字下划线连字符，2~32 位，不能和内置重名 |
| `short` / `color` / `unit` | 卡片上的名字、品牌色、积分单位 |
| `checkin` | 签到请求：method / url / headers / body |
| `status` | 状态查询（可选）：怎么看出今天签没签、得了多少 |
| `claimedPath` | 从响应里取「今天签没签」的路径，如 `data.checked_in_today` |
| `pointsPath` | 从响应里取「今天得了多少」 |
| `successPath` / `successValue` | 成功的判据，如 `code` 等于 `0` |
| `alreadyPath` | 这个字段为 true 表示今天已签（跳过重复请求） |

**路径写法**：点号分隔，数组下标用 `[0]`，例如 `data.list[0].status`。

**凭据**：在卡片详情的「账号」里填，字段名随便叫（`cookie` / `token` / `key`），
然后在 `url` / `headers` / `body` 里用 `{{字段名}}` 引用。这样一份定义能配多个账号。

定义存在 `~/.dsh/dsh-checkin-all/custom-services.json`（0600），可以随时删。

## 多账号

**每个服务都能配多个账号**，签到时会逐个签，结果分别汇报。

面板里：切到对应服务 → 「账号」卡片 → 填凭据 → 点「添加账号」。想区分就在「备注名」里写「主号 / 小号」。
已配的账号列在上面，每个后面有「删除」。

命令行：

```bash
# 加账号（同一个服务可以加多次）
node bin/dsh-checkin-all.js set lingxi "<wps_sid>" --name 主号
node bin/dsh-checkin-all.js set lingxi "<另一个 wps_sid>" --name 小号
```

存储结构（`~/.dsh/dsh-checkin-all/secrets.json`，0600）：

```json
{ "checkin": { "manual": {
  "lingxi": { "accounts": [
    { "id": "1", "name": "主号", "wps_sid": "..." },
    { "id": "2", "name": "小号", "wps_sid": "..." }
  ] }
} } }
```

**老的单个凭据会自动迁移**：升级后第一次读取会把扁平结构当成 1 个账号，不会丢数据。

汇总规则：任一账号签上就算 `claimed`，积分累加，连续天数取最大的那个；
部分账号失败不影响其他账号，消息里会点名是哪个失败了。

支持多账号的：灵犀、DuMate、AStudio、Qoder、Trae、豆包、CodeArts、WorkBuddy、小浣熊、TeleAgent。
**MiniMax 例外**——它的凭据是 App 里的 OAuth 文件（`~/.minimax/auth/`），
天然只有一份，且 refresh token 一次性，不适合手动塞多份 token。

## 配置

面板里改，或者 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里给 `id: dsh-checkin-all` 加 `config`：

```yaml
- id: dsh-checkin-all
  config:
    enabled: true      # 是否自动签到
    time: '09:00'      # 每天几点签（北京时间）
    catchUp: true      # 过了时间才开机是否补签
    notify: true       # 签完是否提示
```

面板里可以给每个服务单独设开关和时间（存在 `config.json` 的 `providers` 字段里）。

插件自己的数据（设置、签到历史）在 `~/.dsh/dsh-checkin-all/`：

- `config.json` — 设置（全局 + 每个服务的 `providers` 覆盖）
- `state.json` — 按服务分开记：最近一次结果、连续天数、累计积分、每天一条记录（保留 400 天）
  ```
  { "version": 2, "providers": { "minimax": {...}, "lingxi": {...} } }
  ```
  老版本的单服务 `state.json` 会自动迁移成 `providers.minimax`，历史不丢。

## 接口与凭据

### MiniMax Code

MiniMax Code 桌面端自己用的就是这两个接口，插件原样调用（`lib/signin.js`）：

```
GET  https://agent.minimax.io/minimax-cloud/api/v1/signin/status?timezone_id=<IANA>
POST https://agent.minimax.io/minimax-cloud/api/v1/signin/claim?timezone_id=<IANA>
Authorization: Bearer <access token>
```

`agent.minimax.io` / `agent.minimax.cn` 按 region 分（`en` / `cn`）。**必须带 `timezone_id`**，
不带会报 `invalid timezone_id`——这是「按谁的一天算」的关键。

凭据（`lib/credentials.js`）：

```
~/.minimax/auth/<buildEnv>/<region>/mcode-public/auth.json        # { schemaVersion, records: { "<service>\0<account>": {...} } }
~/.minimax/auth/<buildEnv>/<region>/mcode-public/auth-state.json  # generation / expiresAtMs 必须和凭据对得上
```

- `service` = `com.minimax.mcode.oauth.<buildEnv>.<region>`
- `account` = `base64url(sha256("<authHome>\0mcode-public"))`
- 文件 `0600`、目录 `0700`（App 会检查，太宽直接拒绝读）
- 写回在 `auth.lock` 的锁里做，和 App 自己的 `proper-lockfile` 兼容
- refresh token 是一次性的：换一次旧的就作废，所以必须写回

### WPS 灵犀

```
GET  https://lingxi.wps.cn/api/public/v1/tasks                       # 任务列表
POST https://lingxi.wps.cn/api/public/v1/tasks/daily_check_in/claim  # 签到
Cookie: wps_sid=<...>
```

签到数据在 `tasks[].task_key === "daily_check_in"` 那条里：

```
extra.check_in_days      七天签到表 [{day, date, reward, status}]
extra.consecutive_days   连续签到天数（断一天就回 1）
extra.today_day          今天是第几天
data.total_claimed_credits  账户累计智点
status: claimed / available / locked
```

凭据（`lib/providers/lingxi.js`）：读灵犀自己的 `Cookies`（SQLite，用 `node:sqlite` 只读打开），
取 `wps_sid`。位置：`~/Library/Application Support/WPS 灵犀/Cookies`。

**日期按北京时间算**——服务器返回的 `date` 是北京日期。本机在美西时，晚上 8 点之后就已经是北京的第二天，
所以灵犀的签到窗口和 MiniMax 完全不同，代码里两个 provider 分开判断。

### 百度 DuMate（搭子）

```
GET  https://console.bce.baidu.com/api/dumate/points/loginBonusInfo   签到状态
POST https://console.bce.baidu.com/api/dumate/points/loginBonus       领今天的分
GET  https://console.bce.baidu.com/api/dumate/points/quota_overview   积分总览
Cookie: <解密出来的 cookie>; csrftoken: <bce-user-info 的值>
```

`loginBonusInfo` 返回：

```json
{"totalTimes":2,"totalPoints":1000,"hasIssued":true,"signInDays":["2026-11-01","2026-11-02"]}
```

**坑：必须带 `csrftoken` 头**（值来自 `bce-user-info` cookie，去掉引号）。
少了它服务端一律回 `{"success":false,"message":{"global":"登录凭证已过期，请重新登录"}}`——
这句话是误导的，cookie 其实好好的。注意不是 `X-Bce-Csrf-Token`，就叫 `csrftoken`。

凭据（`lib/providers/dumate.js`）：DuMate 把 cookie 加密存在
`~/Library/Application Support/qianfan-desktop-app/auth.json` 的 `cookies` 字段：

```
base64( iv(12) || authTag(16) || ciphertext )   AES-256-GCM
密钥：同目录 .cookie-key 的 32 字节
```

插件用 `node:crypto` 解密（不需要额外的原生模块）。

### AStudio（星火）

AStudio 的「签到」= **每日登录积分**：每天首次连上时自动到账，桌面端用「每日积分」弹窗提示。
插件复刻同一套调用（`lib/providers/astudio.js`）：

```
GET  points/balance                积分余额（通用 + 星火）
GET  points/summary                积分摘要
GET  membership/me                 当前套餐
GET  membership/plan-config        每日登录积分配置（按套餐给 dailyLoginPoints）
GET  client-popups/pending         待展示/待领取弹窗（每日积分在这里）
POST client-popups/complete        领取（body: { popupId, instanceKey }）
```

- 上游：`https://agent.xfyun.cn/xingchen-studio/`
- 认证：`Cookie` + 身份头 `clientType` / `studioVersion`
  - `clientType` 按平台自动上报：Windows `21`、macOS/Linux `22`
  - `studioVersion` 默认 `3.5.5`，可用环境变量 `ASTUDIO_VERSION` 覆盖
- 「今天」按**北京时间**算

凭据（`lib/providers/astudio.js`）读 AStudio 的登录态文件 `astron-session.json`：

```
# macOS / Linux
~/.acode/acode/userdata/astron-session.json
# Windows
%USERPROFILE%\.acode\acode\userdata\astron-session.json
# { accountId, uid, token, ssoSessionId, mobile, ... }
```

凭据目录可用 `ASTUDIO_DATA_DIR` 环境变量覆盖（VPS 部署时指到同步目录）。

拼出的 Cookie（和桌面端 `buildAstronCookieHeader` 一致）：

```
ssoSessionId=<ssoSessionId>; sso_sessionid=<ssoSessionId>; account_id=<accountId>; token=<token>
```

### Qoder

Qoder 的「签到」= **每日领取 CLAIM_BENEFIT 赠送积分**，与 Qoder 桌面端「用量面板」的领取链路一致
（`lib/providers/qoder.js`）：

```
POST {openApi}/api/v1/jobToken/exchange         PAT 换短期 jobToken
GET  {openApi}/sash/api/v1/me/campaigns         找当天的 CLAIM_BENEFIT 活动
POST {openApi}/sash/api/v1/me/campaigns/{id}/claim   幂等领取（重复返回 replayed）
```

- 国内版 `https://openapi.qoder.com.cn`，国际版 `https://openapi.qoder.sh`
- 凭据有两条路，**优先用本机 Qoder App 的登录**（零配置）：
  1. 本机 Qoder 桌面 App 登录态：`<App Support>/com.qoder.app.stable/auth.v1.dat`
     （Electron safeStorage，密钥在钥匙串「Qoder App Safe Storage」），
     解出来直接当 token 用；`authenticationContext` 里是 `openapi.qoder.sh` 就走国际版
  2. 个人访问令牌（PAT）：面板里填，存 `~/.dsh/dsh-checkin-all/secrets.json`（0600），
     会先打 `exchange` 接口验真再落盘
- 「今天」按**北京时间**算

#### ⚠️ 自动签到时间会自动对齐到 10:00

Qoder 的每日活动是 **10:00 → 次日 09:59** 一轮。在 10:00 之前看到的还是**上一轮**：
如果按全局的 09:00 去签，会读到「已领」（其实是昨天那轮的），于是把当天标成已完成，
10:00 新一轮出来后再也不会重试 —— 这正是以前「手动能签、自动签不上」的原因。

现在两处都改了：

- `PROVIDER_EARLIEST_TIME` 把 qoder 的最早签到时间抬到 **10:00**（你手动设过更早的时间则以你的为准）
- 「还没到轮次」（`not_yet`）**不占用当天记录**，只做退避重试，到点自然会签上

**获取 PAT**：令牌在 **Qoder 网页版**创建，**不在桌面 App 里**（App 里翻不到，这是最容易卡住的地方）：

1. 浏览器登录 Qoder
2. 打开 <https://qoder.com/account/integrations>（海外版）或 <https://qoder.com.cn/account/integrations>（国内版）
3. 点「创建令牌」，复制 —— 以 `pt-` 开头，**只显示一次**

旧版页面可能在「设置 → API 令牌」或「账号 → 集成」下面。

拿到后粘贴到面板「Qoder 令牌」卡片（点卡片头部的「配置令牌」），选区域（国内/海外）、可加备注名，点「添加令牌」——插件会先打 `exchange` 接口验真再落盘。也支持多个令牌（多账号）。

> 注意：dsh-model 的 Qoder 签到**只支持 PAT**，它不会去读 Qoder 桌面 App。
> 本插件多了一条路：本机 Qoder App 登录着就直接读（见上），不用创建令牌。

### 豆包

豆包的「天天领额度」每日签到（`lib/providers/doubao.js` + `browser-cookies.js`）：

```
POST https://www.doubao.com/alice/ug/campaign/v3/detail/        任务面板
POST https://www.doubao.com/alice/ug/campaign/landing/checkin   领取（幂等，重复返回 idempotent:true）
```

- 凭据：豆包登录 Cookie（`doubao.com`），在面板里手动粘贴，或点「从本机豆包读」（豆包电脑版 / Chrome / Edge / Brave）
- 「今天」按**北京时间**算

#### ⚠️ 只有个人账号有签到，工作版没有

**豆包工作版（DoubaoWork，`com.work.pc.doubao`）和飞书企业账号没有「每日签到」这个玩法。**
它们的任务面板长这样：

```
tasks[].task_kind = chat_activity   ← 全是聊天任务，没有 daily_signin
milestones[] = 累计 2000 / 5000 点额度里程碑
progress.total_amount = 0
```

直接调签到接口，服务端会回：

```json
{ "code": 710010702, "msg": "系统错误", "data": null }
```

**注意这个错误码不是登录失效**（失效是 `710012001`）。`710010702` 表示 cookie 是好的，
但这个账号没有可领的签到活动。插件会识别成 `no_task` 状态并说明原因，不当作故障重试。

判断账号类型：Cookie 里有 `feishu_dpop_keypair` / `has_biz_token` 基本就是工作/企业号，
换个人豆包账号（[doubao.com](https://www.doubao.com) 网页版登录后的 Cookie）即可。


### 华为 CodeArts

华为云 CodeArts 的每日登录积分（`lib/providers/codearts.js`）。四步，全部打同一个网关，
每个请求都要**华为云 SDK-HMAC-SHA256 签名**：

```
GET  https://snap-access.cn-north-4.myhuaweicloud.com/snap-manager/v1/statistics/plugin   账户信息
GET  .../v1/ops/delivery?channel=IDE                                                      活动列表
POST .../v1/ops/claim   {"campaignId":"1","channel":"IDE"}                                 领取
POST .../v1/ops/confirm {"campaignId":"1"}                                                 确认
```

- 凭据：**点面板的「登录」按钮，浏览器授权一次就有了**，不用手抠 AK/SK。
  也可以手动配 `{ access_key_id, secret_access_key, security_token? }` 或 `set codearts`

#### 浏览器登录怎么走的

和官方 CodeArts 插件同一条链路（`lib/providers/codearts-login.js`）：

1. 本地起回调服务器 `http://127.0.0.1:8791/authentication`（端口占用就换随机的）
2. 打开 `auth.huaweicloud.com`，带上回调地址和 ticket
3. 你在浏览器登录并同意授权，华为云把请求转回本地
4. 用回调里的 secret 去 `snap-manager/v1/login/ticket` 换临时 AK/SK/security_token
5. 自动写进 `secrets.json`，面板上就变「已登录」

拿到的 `security_token` 是华为云 STS 临时凭据，过期后重新点一次「登录」即可。
- **不是所有账户都能签**：`is_credit_package=false`（Token 计费账户）直接判为没有这个活动
- 幂等靠 `claimable` + `status`（`CLAIMED`/`CONFIRMED`/`CONSUMED` 算已领），不会重复 POST

签名有三个坑（实现里都处理了，`test/providers.test.js` 有逐字节比对）：

1. **参与签名的 URI 必须补尾斜杠**：`/v1/ops/claim` 要按 `/v1/ops/claim/` 签，但请求仍打不带斜杠的
2. `host` 参与签名但**不要手动设** header，交给运行时
3. claim 的 body 有 `channel`、confirm 的**没有** —— 两个 body 不同，签名必须各算各的

#### 浏览器登录怎么走的

和官方客户端同一条链路（`lib/providers/buddy-login.js`）：

1. `POST /v2/plugin/auth/state?platform=ide` → 拿 `state` 和授权地址
2. 打开授权页（补 `version` + `loginSessionId`），你在浏览器登录腾讯账号
3. 轮询 `GET /v2/plugin/auth/token?state=` —— 未确认时服务端回 `code 11217 "login ing..."`
4. 拿到 token 后查 `GET /v2/plugin/login/account?state=` 补 user_id / enterprise_id
5. 写进 `secrets.json` 的 `manual.buddy.accounts[]`

两个产品线各自独立：国内版（`copilot.tencent.com`）填 `region: cn`，
国际版 WorkBuddy（`www.workbuddy.ai`）填 `region: intl`。命令行：

```bash
node bin/dsh-checkin-all.js login buddy          # 国内版
node bin/dsh-checkin-all.js login buddy intl     # 国际版
```

### 腾讯 WorkBuddy

腾讯 WorkBuddy 的每日领取（`lib/providers/buddy.js`）。

> 对外统一叫 **WorkBuddy**。底层有两个产品线，技术标识 `productCode` 分别是
> `codebuddy`（国内版）和 `workbuddy`（国际版）—— 那是发给服务端的，不能改。

```
POST {endpoint}/v2/billing/meter/checkin-activity-status   活动状态（active / today_checked_in / streak）
POST {endpoint}/v2/billing/meter/daily-checkin             领取
POST {endpoint}/v2/billing/meter/get-user-resource         余额
```

- 国内版 `https://copilot.tencent.com`（有签到）；国际版 WorkBuddy `https://www.workbuddy.ai`
  **只有模型接入、没有签到**（上游能力表就是空的）
- 认证是一串头，少一个服务端只回 401 HTML（很难看出原因）：
  ```
  Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
  X-Domain: copilot.tencent.com
  X-Product: SaaS
  X-Product-Code: codebuddy
  X-User-Id / X-Enterprise-Id / X-Tenant-Id   有就带
  User-Agent: CodeBuddyIDE/1.106.1
  ```

- 错误码：`10001`/`1001` = 今天已领；`1002` = 无资格；`1003` = 活动结束（后两个按 `no_task` 处理，不当故障重试）

### 商汤小浣熊

商汤「小浣熊」（[xiaohuanxiong.com](https://xiaohuanxiong.com)）的每日积分（`lib/providers/xiaohuanxiong.js`）。

**它没有「点一下签到」的按钮**——每日积分是服务端发的：

- 每天 **00:00（北京时间）** 自动发当日额度，默认当天 24:00 清零
- **当天登录一次**，有效期就从「当天 24:00」延长到 **7 天**（这就是「打卡」的全部意义）
- 免费版 300 积分/日；个人升级版 500/日 + 10000/月；企业版 1000/日/人 + 30000/月

所以插件的「签到」= 用你的登录态读一遍账户，确认今天的额度到账了、顺手发一次心跳续期：

```
GET  /api/web/points/v1/balance                                余额（available_points / user_category）
GET  /api/web/points/v2/bills?paging.limit=20&type=all         积分流水（biz_type=daily_grant / daily_expire）
POST /api/web/auth/v1/devices_current_heartbeat                登录心跳（当日登录 → 有效期延长到 7 天）
```

判定：流水里今天有 `biz_type=daily_grant` → `already_claimed`（已到账，不动）；
没有 → 发心跳 → 再查一次流水，到账了就 `claimed`，还没到就 `not_yet`（服务端延迟，稍后自动重试）。

**登录：点卡片上的「登录」，弹一个窗口，你自己登（`lib/providers/xiaohuanxiong-login.js`）**

不用复制粘贴 Cookie。点「登录」之后插件会：

1. 用**独立 profile** 起一个真的 Chrome 窗口（`~/.dsh/dsh-checkin-all/browser/xiaohuanxiong`），
   直接打开登录页 <https://xiaohuanxiong.com/login?product_code=work&redirect_url=%2Fwork%2Fhome>
   （手机号 / 微信扫码都在这个页面上，登完自动回办公端）
2. 你在那个窗口里照常登录 —— **账号密码只输给官网，插件全程不碰**
3. 插件通过 CDP 读那个窗口里 `xiaohuanxiong.com` 域的 cookie，挑出 `xhx_token` /
   `raccoon_token`，先调一次余额接口**验证真的能用**（游客 token 换不出余额，会被判为还没登录）
4. 验证通过 → 关窗口、把凭据写进 `secrets.json`、顺手把昵称记成账号名

窗口默认等 5 分钟；profile 会留着，下次点「登录」通常已经是登录态，一秒就取到 token。
同一个号重复登录会覆盖原来那条账号记录，不会越登越多；**要换另一个号**，先删掉
`~/.dsh/dsh-checkin-all/browser/xiaohuanxiong` 再点「登录」（新 profile 是干净的未登录态）。

也可以手填（不想开窗口的话）：浏览器打开 xiaohuanxiong.com 登录 → 开发者工具 → Application →
Cookies → 复制 `xhx_token` 的值，粘到面板「配置凭据」。整条 Cookie 或裸 Bearer token 都认；
旧版的 `<前缀>raccoon_token` 也认。

```bash
dsh-checkin-all set xiaohuanxiong xhx_token的值
dsh-checkin-all set xiaohuanxiong "整条 Cookie 串" --name 主号
```

> 为什么是「弹窗口」而不是直接读你日常浏览器的 Cookie：macOS 上读 Chrome/Edge 的 Cookies 库要过
> 沙箱和钥匙串两道（`Operation not permitted`），读不了；而且那样会把用户的浏览数据一起碰。
> 独立 profile 只装小浣熊这一件事，干净、可复用、还能随时删掉。
> 只在装了 Chrome / Edge / Brave / Chromium 的机器上可用；没有浏览器时退回手填。
> token 失效时返回 `needs_login`，面板会提示重新贴一次，不会当故障反复重试。

### 天翼 AI（TeleAgent）

中国电信「天翼 AI」（[agent.teleai.com.cn/teleagent](https://agent.teleai.com.cn/teleagent)）的每日积分
（`lib/providers/teleagent.js`）。

它的签到在「积分福利社」里：服务端每天挂一条活动，用户点「立即领取」才到账。
插件的流程和网页端一模一样：

```
GET  /user/portal/companyStore/userCenter                 账户（current_points_balance 余额）
GET  /user/portal/companyStore/v3/checkDayTask?theme=light 当日活动 activity_data[]
GET  <activity.jump_url>                                   领取（jump_url 就是领取地址）
GET  /user/portal/companyStore/checkTask                   首登礼 / 月度礼
```

- 可领判定：`action_status` ∈ `incomplete` / `not_joined` / `fixed`（和前端同一个集合）
- 领取地址：直接取 `jump_url`，把 `/superCowork/sapi` 前缀去掉后 GET（前端就是这么干的）
- `action_type === 'web'` 的活动只是跳转（不产生领取），跳过
- 接口前缀两套都试：先 `/meter/super-agent/user/portal`（web 门户），不通再退回
  `/superCowork/sapi/user/portal`（桌面端）

判定：有可领活动 → 逐个领 → 重读一次状态 → `claimed`（带本次拿到的积分）；
都已经领完 → `already_claimed`；有活动但服务端没给结果 → `not_yet`（稍后自动重试）。

**登录：和小浣熊一样，点「登录」弹窗口，你自己登**（`lib/providers/teleagent-login.js`）

1. 用独立 profile 起一个 Chrome（`~/.dsh/dsh-checkin-all/browser/teleagent`），打开
   <https://agent.teleai.com.cn/meter/teleagent-login/login>
2. 你在窗口里照常登录（手机号 / 扫码都行，账号密码只输给官网，插件不碰）
3. 插件通过 CDP 读那个窗口 `teleai.com.cn` 域的 cookie，挑出 `operationToken`
   （读不到就读 localStorage 的 `user_token` / `sso_token` / `console_token`），
   先调一次 userCenter **验证真的能用**，通过才写进 `secrets.json`

也可以手填：浏览器登录后开发者工具 → Application → Cookies 复制 `operationToken`，
粘到面板「配置凭据」；整条 Cookie 或裸 token 都认。

```bash
dsh-checkin-all set teleagent operationToken的值
dsh-checkin-all set teleagent "整条 Cookie 串" --name 主号
```

> token 失效（HTTP 401 / `code:"4001"`）时返回 `needs_login`，面板提示重新登一次，
> 不会当故障反复重试。要换另一个号，先删掉 `~/.dsh/dsh-checkin-all/browser/teleagent` 再点「登录」。

## 隐私

- 不保存账号密码，只用 App 已经存好的 OAuth 凭据
- 除了 MiniMax 自己的签到接口和 OAuth 接口，不往任何地方发请求
- 签到历史只写在本机 `~/.dsh/dsh-checkin-all/`

## 部署到 VPS（无图形界面）

可以。三个服务都支持，详细步骤见 **[docs/VPS.md](docs/VPS.md)**。

三步：

```bash
# 1) 传代码
rsync -av ~/dsh/dsh-checkin-all/ vps:/opt/dsh-checkin-all/

# 2) 传凭据（在本机跑）
bash ~/dsh/dsh-checkin-all/scripts/sync-to-vps.sh vps

# 3) 装（在 VPS 上）
ssh vps 'bash /opt/dsh-checkin-all/scripts/deploy-vps.sh /opt/dsh-checkin-all'
```

要点（细节见 docs/VPS.md）：

- **时区**：VPS 多是 UTC，灵犀和搭子按北京时间算日期 → 签到时间设 **01:00**
- **MiniMax 的 refresh token 一次性**：VPS 默认只读（`DSH_CHECKIN_ALL_READONLY=1`），
  本机要定时 `sync-to-vps.sh` 同步；或者干脆只让 VPS 跑、本机关掉
- **灵犀和搭子不受限制**：cookie 多处使用不会互相失效

### 环境变量

| 变量 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `MINIMAX_DATA_DIR` | MiniMax 数据根目录（默认 `~/.minimax`） |
| `LINGXI_DATA_DIR` | 灵犀数据目录（默认 macOS 的 `~/Library/Application Support/WPS 灵犀`） |
| `DUMATE_DATA_DIR` | DuMate 数据目录（默认 `~/Library/Application Support/qianfan-desktop-app`） |
| `ASTUDIO_DATA_DIR` | AStudio 用户数据目录（默认 `~/.acode/acode/userdata`） |
| `ASTUDIO_VERSION` | AStudio 版本号（默认自动读 App 的版本，读不到用 `3.5.5`） |
| `DSH_CHECKIN_ALL_READONLY` | `1` = 不刷新 refresh token |
| `DSH_CHECKIN_ALL_HOME` | 插件自己的状态目录（默认 `~/.dsh/dsh-checkin-all`） |

> 凭据文件的记录 key 里嵌了 **authHome 的绝对路径**，换目录后算出来的 key 对不上。
> 插件会自动按 service 前缀兜底找（`lib/credentials.js` 的 `pickRecord`），所以拷过去能用。

# @automagik/acp-dsh

Agents other than DSH's own, as DeepSeek Harness models, over the
[Agent Client Protocol](https://agentclientprotocol.com) (ACP). The design is
[RFC 0003](../../docs/rfcs/0003-model-routes-and-acp.md).

- **Agents as DSH models.** Each agent is a provider route (`acp-<agent>`) whose models are the
  agent's own (Claude Code's Opus, Sonnet, Haiku…; Codex's GPT models), each with the reasoning
  efforts the agent offers for it. A chat or a Bot picks one like any model. DSH keeps the
  Session, its history and the sidebar.
- **The agent's own models and efforts.** They are read from the agent over ACP: its session
  config options of category `model` and `thought_level`. A probe starts the adapter, opens a
  session it never prompts (no turn, no tokens), reads the models, then picks each one to read
  its efforts, since an agent rebuilds that list per model. The result is kept in
  `$AUTOMAGIK_HOME/acp/catalog/<route>.json`, so the next start lists it at once while a new probe
  runs; a new adapter release probes again. Before any probe has answered, a short list stands
  in (Claude Code: `default`, `opus`, `sonnet`, `haiku` at low, medium or high effort; Codex:
  `default`). The model `default` is always listed: it is whatever the agent's own settings
  choose. An effort's default is the person's own setting for that model.
- **The Session's model and effort, before each prompt.** The agent's session is put on the
  Session's model, then its effort (the model first: the efforts are that model's). No effort
  leaves the agent's own. A model or effort the agent does not offer normally fails the turn,
  naming what it offers. For a missing stand-in, if the agent's own model is still available,
  DSH accepts an effort the known catalog offers for one of its models, and the reply uses the
  agent's own model and effort and asks you to choose a model again.
- **DSH tool cards and approvals.** With `dshTools` off (the kill switch), the agent runs its own
  tools. Each tool call it makes ends the model step with a call to `acp_tool`, a tool registered
  in that agent's scope only. DSH writes the `tool/call` and `tool/result` rows and draws the
  card (a terminal for a command, a diff for an edit, the generic card otherwise). When the agent
  asks permission for the call, `acp_tool` asks DSH's approval service
  (`approval/asked`, `approval/decided`) and gives the agent DSH's answer. On DSH's Auto
  review level that answer is the review. A call the reviewer allowed, or that the person
  allowed in the dialog the reviewer raised, gets `allow_once` for the agent's first question
  about it, with no second dialog; this holds in a subagent child too. Later questions, calls
  the agent changes after review, and level changes can still raise a dialog. When the mirror
  body gets a question offering `allow_always` without `allow_once`, it replies with `reject_once`
  if offered or cancels the question, skips its dialog, and explains why in the result text.
  Under an Automagik Codex permission profile, the mirror skips the dialog and refuses when Codex
  asks to run a new command outside the sandbox because Codex keeps the profile's deny rule even
  after approval, with the refusal reason shown as the turn's last line if Codex cancels the prompt.
  Network, MCP and additional-permission questions still ask. An input question
  for a running command has the same wire format as a new command escalation and is refused
  the same way.
- **DSH's own tools over the bridge (`dshTools`).** On, the agent gets the Session's preset tool
  set (standard, or cordis in creator mode) over one stdio MCP server per ACP session, named
  `dsh` and spawned by the adapter with that session's arguments. The bridge has no port; it
  reaches this plugin over a loopback back-channel with a per-session credential
  (`DSH_BRIDGE_CREDENTIAL`), which binds a request to its Session. A bridge process that exits
  detaches, and a respawn can re-attach with the same credential. The host revokes it when the
  ACP session ends, its agent process exits, a fork replaces it, or the probe ends.
  Every DSH tool call is approved in DSH under the Session's level before it runs,
  whatever the agent's own allow rules or hooks say, and the bridge writes the `tool/call` and
  `tool/result` rows the chat shows. `acp-claude` runs with its built-in tools off
  (`_meta.disableBuiltInTools`); a structured call that is not an MCP name is recorded as
  `plugin:acp-dsh/toolset-drift` and its turn is cancelled — the detector runs at every session
  start, and it detects and cancels because the update arrives after the call began.
  DSH's `read_image` works for Claude Code because acp-dsh declares its models as taking images;
  other ACP agents keep no declaration.
  `acp-codex` keeps its own tools. A team Bot gets DSH's extras over the bridge by default,
  with Codex's own tools taking the place of DSH's twins. An explicit `dshTools: true` gives
  Codex the whole DSH preset. Until a structured name is proven in its tool calls, it draws no
  ACP card for an MCP call. The person's own MCP servers load beside the bridge with their own
  tools and sign-ins: DSH hands the session
  only the `dsh` bridge, so any other `mcp__<server>__<tool>` is the CLI's own user-scope config
  (claude-agent-acp merges the person's settings MCP servers into the session), it passes the
  drift allowlist by design, and DSH's Auto review does not gate it: the agent's own rules and
  sign-in govern that call. A tool-list change
  (a preset or level change) is announced on `acp-claude` and arrives through `session/fork`
  plus `session/close` on `acp-codex`; a bridge that never lists its tools fails the turn
  (`acp_bridge_missing`) before the prompt. **Auto:** DSH's Auto preset is full access's sandbox
  with asks answered by auto-review. A bridge call adds one marked, tool-only assistant block:
  the advertisement the Session format requires before its tool/call row, which the reviewer
  reads too, and which is removed from the surface once the call settles and never replayed to
  another provider; the reviewer sees the bridge tool, its redacted arguments and its schema
  before the body runs. A denial is `AUTO_REVIEW_DENIED`, a failed reviewer refuses with
  `AUTO_REVIEW_FAILED`, a review past its deadline is `AUTO_REVIEW_TIMEOUT`, and the call never
  runs. A call that comes between two steps of a turn while the agent's prompt is still running
  (after a `step/end`, before the next `step/start`) waits for the next step, at most 30 s, and is
  recorded and reviewed there; it ends with no rows if the turn ends, its caller goes away, the
  bridge is revoked or the turn is stopped (#969). Otherwise a Manual or Full call with no open
  step is `BRIDGE_NO_STEP` (Auto: `AUTO_REVIEW_NO_STEP`). A call in a turn the agent opened
  itself, with no DSH turn at all, is different: at Manual or Full it runs without a card and
  leaves a `plugin:acp-dsh/bridge-outside-step` record; at Auto it is refused as
  `BRIDGE_OUTSIDE_STEP` with what to do next, because Auto review cannot see a call outside a
  DSH step. One whose advertisement or call row cannot be written is `BRIDGE_RECORD_FAILED`,
  and the call does not run. The rows' call id is the agent's own `_meta.callId` only when it is
  1 to 128 characters of `A-Z a-z 0-9 _ . : -`
  and does not start with `acp_` (the mirror's ids); otherwise the plugin mints `bridge_<16 hex>`
  and logs the replacement. **Codex's MCP approvals.** With `dshTools` on, `acp-codex`'s MCP calls
  get no mirror card (it gives them no structured name), so a `session/request_permission` Codex
  sends for one (codex-acp's MCP tool approval) is answered at once: for the `dsh` server, allow
  once when the question offers it (the bridge's own approval is the one dialog), else cancelled,
  never `allow_always` (RFC 0039; an agent may then end its turn); for any other or unnamed server,
  the agent's reject option, which is logged, or cancelled when it offers none (#969). A question
  that can no longer be answered is cancelled first. **A call that
  outlives its step (#957).** The agent runs its calls in parallel, and the bridge puts no
  deadline on one (a long wait, a slow command and an open approval dialog are legitimate).
  Before its step ends, an own-tool card waits for bridge calls of that step asking for approval
  or under Auto review to write their results, with no deadline; Full-access calls are unchanged.
  Stop, revoke and the prompt's end release the wait.
  The write guard still closes calls a forced boundary leaves open before `step/end` and drops
  their late results; the agent still gets the real answer.
  Each call has its own abort controller: Stop, the end of its turn and a caller that
  went away (an MCP `notifications/cancelled`, a closed request) stop that call as
  `BRIDGE_CANCELLED` and keep the bridge. A call whose `tool/call` row cannot be written is
  answered with DSH's own not-started row, and a bridge revoked with a call in flight keeps
  the guard until that call is over. The reviewer
  goes to the same non-agent side model as a Session title. Manual asks (one dialog), Full
  access does not. A Session that moves between providers carries its transcript
  redacted at each crossing — the replay out to an agent, and the transcript handed back to a
  native provider — and each crossing writes a provider-boundary row the chat shows,
  "Switching to X": it is written before the reply and claims no answer, since the call can
  still fail after it. An agent whose CLI is signed out (ACP's `auth_required`, when its session
  opens or on a prompt) fails the turn as `MODEL_ACCESS_REQUIRED`, not `ACP_AGENT`. The
  reasoning effort the Session ran on crosses with it, both ways, when the target model offers
  that level (matched by id, else by name), replacing the target default DSH records on a model
  change; an effort DSH itself defaulted is not carried. The agents' levels are their own
  `thought_level` ids: Claude Code lists low, medium, high, xhigh and max, and Codex lists low,
  medium, high, xhigh, max and ultra, per model. A target with no reasoning levels, without
  that one, or whose levels cannot be read writes a notice row saying so and runs on its own.
  A switch back before the agent has answered drops the agent's chosen level; the native
  target's own default applies.
- **Only the chat reaches the agent.** DSH's side requests on an ACP route never become
  prompts. At the `llm/stream` waterfall a Session title (`purpose: session-title`) goes to a
  model that answers on its own, without the agent's effort. That is the first model the team
  can reach: DSH's default model (`agentDefaultModel`) when it is not an agent; else a
  `sideModel` the person chose; else each configured non-agent route in turn (its first model,
  at most eight); and only then the built-in DeepSeek Flash fallback. A credential or
  missing-route failure on one candidate moves to the next, so a team without a DeepSeek key
  reviews and titles on the model it does have; only no answer at all refuses. Auto review
  (`purpose: auto-review`) takes the same route, with its messages redacted first. Every other
  side request on an ACP route, a compaction summary included, is refused (`UNSUPPORTED`): it
  would carry the agent's whole chat to another provider, and the agent manages its own context.
  Sessions on any other route are left alone.
- **A switch onto an agent passes DSH's compaction guard.** `compaction-basic` prices every model
  switch on the destination's context window, which an agent does not declare, so a switch onto
  an agent in a Session with a request header used to fail with `MODEL_SWITCH_COMPACTION_FAILED`.
  This plugin wraps the engine's `compactPressure` (`src/host/pressure.js`, the method's only
  Automagik owner): an agent destination needs no compaction, every other destination goes to the
  engine unchanged. The wrapper is adopted when an agent is created and on its requests (a
  reloaded compaction plugin is a new engine), delegates to whatever is below it at call time, and
  on dispose unwinds only when it is on top. The method is private to `compaction-basic`; a guard
  test pins it, and a DSH flag for it is proposed upstream (RFC 0023). A switch *off* an agent is
  the destination's own business: for a Bot, the Bot team decides before the guard (its README,
  "Long chats").
- **Host only.** No browser half, so the plugin cannot stop the web UI from loading. With no
  agent CLI installed it registers no route. The welcome draws its setup from the `acpAgents`
  service below.
- **The Session's level, as the agent's own mode.** Before each prompt the agent's ACP session
  mode follows the Session: Manual is Claude Code's `default` mode, whatever default mode its
  own settings name; Codex runs in the sandbox that matches DSH's. DSH Auto review is Claude Code's `auto`
  and Codex's `agent`; it is the preset's identity, never just its sandbox and ask, so a custom
  preset with the same knobs keeps Manual (and the bridge's own approval). Full access lets every
  call through, as it does DSH's own tools. An agent that does not offer the strict mode fails
  the turn instead of running in its own default.
  A Workspace Session on Codex, bridged or unbridged, can take `agent` when the Bot team's
  `ownMode` answerer returns exactly `true` twice, before the prompt. RFC 0031 question 5 withholds
  Claude Code's own `auto` mode until it is captured from a signed-in CLI. After a Codex session
  has attempted its own mode, any Workspace prompt that does not take it re-sends and confirms
  strict `workspace-write` (or its chat profile below), even if cached; refusal ends the agent
  session and fails the turn.
  Sessions that never attempt the own mode keep the usual mode cache and failure handling.
  Auto never requests `bypassPermissions` or
  `agent-full-access`. Codex's own reviewer decides those steps, based on the
  [Codex 0.167.0 capture](test/fixtures/permission-payloads/README.md); later versions may
  decide differently. Any approval Codex still requests goes to the person.
  Reads are not among those steps: in `agent` a read outside the workspace is no sandbox
  escalation, so Codex's own tools read files outside the Bot's folder, wherever the OS user
  running Codex can read, without its reviewer deciding and without asking the person. The
  question before saving says so (RFC 0031, 2026-11-19 amendment, delivery 3; see the security
  warning (#870) below). Delivery 4 moves Auto to an auto-reviewed mode of the Workspace profile
  where the adapter offers one; where it does not (an older adapter, Windows, a Bot home whose
  profile check failed), Auto keeps `agent` and these reads.
- **An agent that stops answering never holds the chat.** Its start (`initialize`,
  `session/new`, the bridge's first list) has 60 seconds, and each request after that and
  before a prompt (a model, an effort, a mode, a fork, a close) has 15. Past the deadline, or
  on Stop, the agent's process and its bridge are ended and the turn says what happened. A
  start that hangs is usually a CLI waiting for the person (a first-run question, a keychain
  dialog, an update), so that message says to open it once in a terminal. Stop ends the turn
  at once and gives the agent 5 seconds to end its prompt, because `session/cancel` is only a
  notification. An agent that ignores it is ended, and the next message starts a new agent
  session with the chat replayed to it (with `dshTools: false`, the new-session notice
  instead). A message sent while the agent is still on its last prompt waits those 5 seconds,
  then gets a new session in the same turn. Ending an agent ends what it started too (the
  command behind a stuck tool call): the agent leads its own process group, which is asked to
  end and killed 3 seconds later if any of it is left; on Windows its process tree is killed.
- **Claude Code keeps the person's own settings.** It loads their Claude Code settings (user,
  project and local) and asks DSH only for what those leave as "ask". A call their allow rules,
  saved "always allow" rules or PreToolUse/PermissionRequest hooks approve runs with no DSH
  dialog. This is the owner's decision (RFC 0003, Decided).

### Native-tools mode (`nativeTools`, #1564)

Claude Code keeps its own tools and Automagik adds its extras. The owner's words: "my intention
is to use claude code + automagik extras, not replace claude code native`s with automagik`s,
that makes your harness lose all your power."

- **The setting.** `nativeTools` in this plugin's config (the `acpAgents` service's plugin,
  `acp-dsh`), hidden from settings forms like `dshTools`. Absent (the default) or `false` is
  today's behaviour for everyone. `true` turns it on for every Claude Code Session; an object
  turns it on per Bot, by the Bot's name, or per DSH Session id. A key that says `false` wins
  over one that says `true`. For one Bot, in the profile patch:

  ```yaml
  - id: acp-dsh
    name: "@automagik/acp-dsh"
    config:
      nativeTools:
        Automagik: true
  ```

  It is read at each turn's start: a flip takes effect on that Session's next turn, in a new
  agent session (the replay carries the chat to it). Only `acp-claude` takes it (the only agent
  whose built-ins the bridge turns off); with `dshTools: false` it has no effect, since the
  agent then already runs only its own tools.
- **What changes when on.** The session starts with `_meta.disableBuiltInTools: false`, so
  Claude Code has its Agent (subagents), Bash, Read, Edit, Write, Grep, Glob, Skill, TodoWrite
  and the rest. The `dsh` bridge stays on but drops DSH's twin of each built-in and the DSH
  subagent family (`NATIVE_TWIN_TOOLS` in `src/host/backchannel.js`: `bash`, `job_*`, `read`,
  `write`, `edit`, `read_image`, `apply_patch`, `str_replace_editor`, `glob`, `grep`, `skill`,
  `todo_write`, `subagent`, `subagent_fork`, `list_agents`, `send_message`, `interrupt_agent`,
  `wait_agent`, `list_subagent_models`, and `web_search`/`web_fetch`/`exit_plan_mode` once they
  are offered). Everything else stays: the Bot team's tools (`message_bot`, `ask_user`,
  `show_view`, `remember`/`recall`, groups, secrets, browser, mail...), goals, `workflow`,
  `working_directory` and schedules. A built-in call is no longer drift.
- **Approvals stay DSH's.** Each native call ends the model step with its `acp_tool` mirror
  card, exactly as with the bridge off: when Claude Code asks permission, DSH's approval answers
  it at the Session's level, and a refusal reaches Claude Code as its own reject option before
  the call runs. The hard ask rules (`CLAUDE_HARD_ASK`) are injected as session settings, so the
  person's allow rules cannot silently skip the ask for those Bash cases. A subagent's nested
  call asks while its Agent card is still waiting. At Auto the Agent card runs the nested call's
  own card through DSH's tool pipeline inside the step it holds open, so DSH's Auto review sees
  and answers it like any other call; the person is asked only when the review escalates (or the
  Bot team's judge, where one is set), and a delegated child that may never ask is refused. At
  Manual and Full the Agent card asks DSH for the nested call directly, as before, and the
  nested card follows already answered. At Auto the nested card is written before the Agent
  card's result, and the agent's later report of that call draws no second card.

  | Level | Claude Code mode | What asks DSH | What can bypass DSH |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | Manual | `default` | every native call its own settings leave as "ask"; DSH's dialog answers | a call its own allow rules or hooks allow (the hard asks still ask) |
  | DSH Auto review | `auto` | only what Claude Code's auto mode asks about; DSH Auto review answers every call, a subagent's nested call included; the person only when the review escalates | whatever its auto mode runs without asking |
  | Full | `bypassPermissions` | nothing; no hard asks injected | every native call |

  Manual is the guarded level; Auto is convenience, and its review sees only what reaches the
  mirror.
- **A turn Claude Code opens itself.** A native background task or subagent can finish after its
  DSH turn ended and wake Claude Code on its own. There is no DSH step then, and none can be
  opened out of band because the DSH agent loop owns turn numbering. At Manual and Full the
  extra still runs, without a DSH card, and a `plugin:acp-dsh/bridge-outside-step` record marks
  it. At Auto it is refused with `BRIDGE_OUTSIDE_STEP` and a sentence naming the cause and what
  to do (send a message, so the next turn has a DSH step), because Auto review reads a call
  from its step. No call runs unreviewed.
- **Native commands and edits run in Claude Code, outside DSH's file sandbox.** DSH's sandbox,
  its read-before-write policy and its write guard do not see them; the person's OS permissions
  and Claude Code's own permission mode and rules are the boundary. Claude Code's `CLAUDE.md`
  memory is the project's own context, loaded by the CLI; the Bot's memory stays `remember`.

## Agents

Unbridged Claude Code receives per-session ask rules for recursive deletion, destructive Git,
infrastructure and database shell commands at every asking level. These explicit rules also
ask in Claude's auto mode. They are never written to a CLI home and are absent at Full access,
where explicit ask rules would otherwise still ask. Crossing Full access restarts the unbridged
Claude session with the chat replayed, adding or removing the rules; staying at a level reuses it.
Bridged Claude has its built-in tools disabled, so DSH checks its calls instead.

Codex's own tools are excluded: prompt rules under Full access (`approval_policy = never`)
refuse rather than ask, its session-flags configuration has no rules folder, and in `agent`
mode prompt rules reach Codex's reviewer rather than the person. Replacing its entire reviewer
policy or changing codex-acp needs a separate owner decision.

| Route | Agent | Runs | Adapter (newest release) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `acp-claude` | Claude Code | managed or existing `claude` (`CLAUDE_CODE_EXECUTABLE`) | `@agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp` |
| `acp-codex` | Codex | managed or existing `codex` (`CODEX_PATH`) | `@agentclientprotocol/codex-acp` |
| `acp-hermes` | Hermes | existing `hermes`, started as `hermes acp` | none: the CLI is the ACP server |
| `acp-antigravity` | Antigravity | existing `agy`, started as `agy acp` | none: the CLI is the ACP server |
| `acp-omp` | omp | existing `omp`, started as `omp acp` | none: the CLI is the ACP server |
| `acp-fake` | `dev/fake-agent.mjs`, set as `fakeAgent` | Node | none; tests only |

An agent is offered when its managed CLI is ready, or an existing CLI is on PATH or where its
installer puts it (`~/.local/bin`, `/opt/homebrew/bin`, …). The settings `claude: false` or `codex: false` take one away;
`hermes`, `antigravity` and `omp` are off until set to `true` (below). They are
live settings: switching one (from the welcome's Connect AI, its Settings page *Claude Code and
Codex*, or the plugin's own settings form) offers or withdraws the agent at once, with no
restart, and a connector that lands puts its model in the picker the same way
(`llm/adapters-updated`).

### Native-ACP agents: Hermes, Antigravity, omp

These three speak ACP themselves, so there is no adapter package and nothing is installed for
them: the plugin starts the CLI it finds with `acp` (`src/host/agents.js`, `launch`). What
differs from Claude Code and Codex:

- **Off until turned on.** `hermes`, `antigravity` and `omp` are live settings that default to
  `false`. Turning one on is the person's word that Automagik may use the sign-in that CLI
  already has on this computer, shared with their terminal. No account is read for them (none
  of the three has a command that names one), so the account record and its confirm step
  (below) stay Claude Code's and Codex's.
- **Never installed by Automagik.** A CLI that is not here is listed as missing with its
  install page (`cli.state: 'missing'`, `connector.state: 'no-cli'`), never hidden and never
  "installing". Once found, the connector reads `ready` with `native: true`.
- **Sign-in in a terminal.** There is no sign-in from a Bot's chat: `loginStart` refuses with
  `acp-login/terminal` and the command (`hermes acp --setup`, `agy acp --login`, `omp login`),
  and a signed-out turn fails as `MODEL_ACCESS_REQUIRED` naming the same command. Whether the
  agent is signed in is what its own ACP session said: `true` when the session the model read
  opens, `false` on ACP's `auth_required`. That read runs when the CLI changes and once a day,
  and again when the person asks (`refresh()`) while it is not signed in; no other check opens
  a session, because each of these agents keeps every session it opens in its own history.
  A session that opens does not prove a provider key works: a turn that then answers
  `auth_required` reads as signed out at once.
- **Models.** Antigravity offers its models and efforts as config options, as the adapters do.
  Hermes offers them only as the session's own list (`models` in the `session/new` answer,
  switched with `session/set_model`); the plugin reads that list when the agent has no model
  option. omp offers no model list over ACP: it is one model, `default`, its own setting.
- **The level.** Each is put in its own `default` mode before every prompt, whatever the
  Session's level, and what it asks is answered by DSH's approval under that level. Its own
  permission settings still decide what it asks about. One that does not offer `default`
  fails the turn. A table agent with no mode for DSH's level would say so once in the chat.
- **No DSH tool bridge.** DSH's tools do not reach them, even with `dshTools: true`: their
  tool naming over ACP is not proven the way Claude Code's was, and an unrecognised bridge
  call would draw two cards and ask twice. They keep their own tools; the transcript replay on
  a model switch reaches them like any agent.

`dshTools` (live, no schema default) is the bridge, its DSH approval, the drift detector and live
switching above. Absent means the per-agent default. `acp-claude` bridges because its adapter can
drop its own built-in tools. `acp-codex` keeps its own tools and bridges when the Bot team sends
`needsDshTools` in the Session's identity. That bridge serves DSH's extras, with Codex's own
tools taking the place of DSH's twins. An explicit `true` gives Codex the whole DSH preset,
including on a Genie. An explicit `false` is the kill switch for both agents. It keeps the
2026-11-03 behaviour, where each agent keeps its own tools and its own approvals. This rollback
lever stays writable through DSH's settings service or the profile patch. Settings forms hide it
with `.hidden()`. Flipping it either way ends the running agent sessions
and revokes their bridges at once; the DSH Session keeps its transcript and the next turn starts
afresh under the new setting. A flip is also announced on the plugin context as
`acp-dsh/dsh-tools-changed` with `{ on }`: DSH delivers `loader/volatile-update` only to the
plugin whose config changed, so another plugin would never see this one. The Bot team watches
that event, so turning the switch off moves its Claude Bots back at once, and turning it on moves
them again. A listener that throws is logged as a warning; the flip itself and its ended sessions
still hold, and the Bot team reverses at its next start (the route reads off or gone). The default
moves Claude Bots once per team to `acp-claude` (the Bot team's README,
"Claude on ACP"); the bridge probe in `bridge()` still gates the move.

The transcript replay is independent of the bridge: only an explicit `false` turns it off.

The Bot team's identity can carry a `rolePrompt` after the Bot's instructions.
`acp-claude` and `acp-codex` receive it, and the `acpAgents` service lists them in
`rolePromptProviders`. The adapter compares roles at the first non-continuing step after
`turn/start`. The running agent session keeps its role for the rest of that turn, including
steers, interrupted mirror calls and reader failures. If the turn is unknown, each
non-continuing step counts as a new turn. An attach, detach or change starts a new agent session
with the existing renewed replay, which clips the transcript, drops the oldest messages as
needed and omits Bot relay rows. If the peer rejects or cancels the first prompt carrying a role
preamble, the next non-continuing step retires that agent session and starts fresh with the
current identity and replay. With `dshTools: false` the ordinary replay is off and the chat shows
the new-session notice. Interrupted-turn recovery still sends the cut turn's own user rows to
the new session, as on any new session. ACP writes no role text into its own log lines, its
`live` state fields or diagnostics. The peer's output, including stderr in an exit error or a
rejection message, passes through to the turn's error text and to existing log lines that carry
peer output, as it does for instructions.

| `dshTools` | Claude Code: tools | Claude Code: replay | Codex: tools | Codex: replay |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| absent | DSH bridge, its own off | yes | its own only, a team Bot: DSH extras too | yes |
| `true` | DSH bridge | yes | DSH bridge and its own | yes |
| `false` | its own only | no | its own only | no |

With the Codex conversation open, choose **Account → Bot settings → Feedback** and look for its
row under **Permissions**. When the row includes agent details, it reports the DSH bridge state.
To confirm delivery, check the receiving Bot’s chat. If your team has a native browser Bot
(such as `@browse`), you can ask it directly to open a page. In a Bot conversation that offers
a **Browser** tab, you can also open

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
Automagik

A team of AI helpers that lives in your chats.

Automagik is superintelligence, in open building blocks: a team of AI agents in your chats,
and each part usable on its own once it ships; Cloud is still in design.

The film: our own GTM team. The team launching Automagik, at work. Music only, no voice-over.
Watch the film on automagik.si

⬇ Download for Mac  ·  ⬇ Download for Linux

Cloud is coming; no date yet. Join the Cloud waitlist on automagik.si

This repository, Genie and Omni are free and open source, Apache-2.0. Cloud is a private, paid service.
Mac with Apple silicon, macOS 13 or newer · Linux on a 64-bit PC · Windows is not supported yet

--- ## Two modes **Team mode** is the desktop app: a team of long-lived Bots, each with its own name, role, model and memory. They talk to you, to each other and in group chats, run scheduled tasks, and each drives a browser of its own. With an [Omni](https://github.com/automagik-si/omni) connected, your WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack and other channels sit in the same window, and the Bot you put on a chat acts when something happens there. The team runs on [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH). **Code mode** is your code agents in the real [Herdr](https://herdr.dev) window, with the Automagik pack: a sidebar of spaces, Bots and workers across coding harnesses. Nothing in Herdr is rebuilt. The app's switch brings the Herdr window forward on the space for the current Bot's folder, and a button in Herdr brings you back. The app download alone does not set Code mode up: it needs Herdr and the pack, and [the pack's installer](herdr/README.md#install) sets up both. Team mode: the app's switch still says Work. ## The seven blocks Each block is usable alone. - **[Team mode (DSH)](apps/bots-dsh/README.md)**: the Bot team on DeepSeek Harness: long-lived Bots with their own name, role, model and memory, group chats, schedules and the Bot browser. - **[Code mode (Herdr)](herdr/README.md)**: your code agents in the real Herdr window with the Automagik pack; nothing in Herdr is rebuilt. - **[Genie](https://github.com/automagik-si/genie)**: a wish becomes a branch, a test run and a report you approve; `genie desktop` opens it on the team. - **[Omni](https://github.com/automagik-si/omni)**: the service that links your chat apps to Automagik, with its channels and canvases in the same window. - **[Pocket](apps/pocket/README.md)**: your coding agents on your Android phone, paired to your own machines. - **[The meter](meter/usagemeter/README.md)**: usagemeter, the Rust token meter that records usage and cost on the machine and answers `usagemeter query`. - **[Cloud](docs/rfcs/0024-automagik-cloud.md)**: one sign-in, organisations and hosted workspaces, with a rail that opens each. Cloud is designed and accepted, and is not live. When it ships it is a private, paid hosted service: not free and not open source. Only its contracts are public (RFC 0024). ## What makes it yours - **Your model.** Connect the AI account you already have, or an API key from a provider you use. Each Bot runs on the model you give it. - **Your files and memory, on your computer.** What the team keeps is in one folder, `.automagik` in your home folder. Each Bot keeps notes across its conversations, each group chat keeps its own, and the team shares one more. Your chats stay in your Omni. What your Bots read and write goes to the AI account you connected, under that company's terms. - **Secrets the Bots never see.** When a Bot needs an API key, a token or a password, it asks with a card in its own chat. You type the value; the Bot never sees it. - **It asks before it acts as you.** Before a Bot sends a message as you to a person, deletes something or disconnects a channel, it shows you exactly what it will do and asks first. The exceptions: your Main Bot and an Omni Bot read your chats and post to a group, a WhatsApp channel or your own chat with yourself without asking. Any other Bot reads and posts only where you allow: the first time it wants a chat it asks, and you answer **Once**, **Always** or **No**; after **Always** it posts to that group without asking again. ## Install The current release is always at [Releases](https://github.com/automagik-si/automagik/releases/latest). **Mac** (Apple silicon, macOS 13 or newer): 1. [Download Automagik for Mac](https://github.com/automagik-si/automagik/releases/latest/download/Automagik-Mac.dmg). 2. Open **Automagik-Mac.dmg** and drag the Automagik icon onto the Applications folder. 3. Open **Automagik** from Applications. **Linux** (64-bit PC): 1. [Download Automagik for Linux (.deb)](https://github.com/automagik-si/automagik/releases/latest/download/Automagik-Linux.deb) for Ubuntu or Debian. 2. Double-click it and choose **Install**, or run `sudo apt install ./Automagik-Linux.deb`. 3. Open **Automagik** from your apps. On another Linux, use the [AppImage](https://github.com/automagik-si/automagik/releases/latest/download/Automagik-Linux.AppImage). Windows is not supported yet. The app has two things to connect when you are ready: an Omni and an AI account. Both can wait. The full guide, updates, your data and uninstall are in [apps/desktop](apps/desktop/README.md). Code mode installs separately: [herdr](herdr/README.md#install). Pocket: [apps/pocket](apps/pocket/README.md#install). am alone on a host without the Herdr app (install, verify, update, roll back): [am/README.md](am/README.md). **For your code agent**: `npx skills add automagik-si/automagik --skill am` adds the skill that teaches it `am`, Automagik's one command. ## This repository Automagik's plugins for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH), and the Automagik desktop app that runs them, with the Herdr pack (`herdr/`), Pocket (`apps/pocket/`) and the meter (`meter/`). | Folder | Package | What it is | |---|---|---| | [`apps/bots-dsh`](apps/bots-dsh/README.md) | `@automagik/bots-dsh` | The Bot team: long-lived Bots, group chats, memory, settings, scheduled tasks, the Bot browser. Omni's and Genie's plugins build on it. | | [`apps/welcome-dsh`](apps/welcome-dsh/README.md) | `@automagik/welcome-dsh` | The welcome: the octopus, the team step, and Connect AI through DSH's own sign-ins. | | [`apps/acp-dsh`](apps/acp-dsh/README.md) | `@automagik/acp-dsh` | Agents other than DSH's own, over ACP (Agent Client Protocol), as DSH models: the agent's tool calls show as DSH tool cards and ask through DSH's approval dialog (RFC 0003). | | [`apps/locale-pt-br-dsh`](apps/locale-pt-br-dsh/README.md) | `@automagik/locale-pt-br-dsh` | Português: the Bot team's Brazilian Portuguese under DSH's own Portuguese entry. Adds no language of its own, so Settings › General › Language keeps one Portuguese row; a pt-BR choice saved by an older pack moves to DSH's pt. | | [`apps/multiuser-dsh`](apps/multiuser-dsh/README.md) | `@automagik/multiuser-dsh` | Server-side caller admission and attribution for gated workspaces (RFC 0038). | | [`apps/vault-dsh`](apps/vault-dsh/README.md) | `@automagik/vault-dsh` | Bitwarden fields for approved Bot commands, with unlock and mapping in Settings › Secrets (RFC 0034). | | [`apps/desktop`](apps/desktop/README.md) | (the app) | The Automagik desktop app: DSH of its own with the Bot team, the welcome and Omni's channels and canvases. `omni desktop` opens it with Omni preloaded, `genie desktop` with Genie. | Omni's own plugins (its channels and canvases) live with Omni, in [automagik-si/omni](https://github.com/automagik-si/omni) (`apps/omni-channels-dsh`, `apps/omni-canvas-dsh`), and carry Omni's version. ### Install into your own DSH - **The desktop app**: download it from [Releases](https://github.com/automagik-si/automagik/releases/latest), or run `omni desktop`. See [apps/desktop](apps/desktop/README.md). - **Into your own DSH**: add the Automagik market to DSH's plugin market and install from there: ``` https://raw.githubusercontent.com/automagik-si/dsh-marketplace/main/index.json ``` Every Omni also serves a market at `https:///api/market/index.json` with the release of these plugins it was tested with. Nothing here is published to npm. The plugins install as git sources pinned to a release commit, or from the tarballs each release carries (`plugins.json` lists their integrity). ### History `@automagik/bots-dsh` and `@automagik/welcome-dsh` were `@automagik/omni-dsh` and `@automagik/omni-ai-dsh` in automagik-dev/omni (`apps/omni-ui-dsh`, `apps/omni-ai-dsh`), and the desktop app was automagik-dev/omni-desktop. They moved here with their history. What did not change with the names: plugin ids (`omni-ui`, `omni-ai`), routes and browser-storage prefixes. From 3.12 the team's home is Automagik's own (`~/.automagik/bots`, or `~/.automagik/desktop/bots` in the app), and the app's identity is Automagik's (`ai.namastex.automagik`): an app from 3.11.x or before is installed afresh, not updated. - The Bot team's client bundle also answers to its former name, so channels and canvas plugins built before the rename keep working on it. - In your own DSH: install `@automagik/bots-dsh` from the market. With both installed, the newer one runs (they share the plugin id); remove `@automagik/omni-dsh` when you like. A settings row in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` that names `@automagik/omni-dsh` needs its `name:` changed to `@automagik/bots-dsh` to keep applying. ### Versions and releases One version for the whole repository, `3.N` (semver `3.N.0`, N one above the last release: `scripts/version.ts`), above the 2.x builds omni-desktop released. Every merge into dev is a release: `release.yml` tags `v`, publishes the plugin tarballs and `plugins.json`, builds the desktop app into the same release (`desktop-build.yml`), lists the release in [`marketplace/automagik.json`](marketplace/automagik.json), and moves `main` to it. `follow-omni.yml` moves the desktop app to each newer Omni release and cuts a release with it. | Branch | What | |---|---| | `dev` | Integration: pull requests land here; releases are cut from it | | `main` | The latest release, moved by `release.yml` only | ### Develop Bun for the repository's own tooling; the plugins run on Node, as DSH does (`node --test`, esbuild), with Bun installing them; the desktop app uses npm for Electron. ```sh bun install && bun run check # versions, release tooling, market index cd apps/bots-dsh && bun install && bun run harness && bun run test cd apps/welcome-dsh && bun install && bun run harness && bun run test cd apps/desktop && npm ci && npm test node scripts/boot-check.mjs # boot the plugins with Omni's in headless Chromium ``` ### License This repository is Apache-2.0. See [LICENSE](LICENSE) and [NOTICE](NOTICE). [Genie](https://github.com/automagik-si/genie) and [Omni](https://github.com/automagik-si/omni) are Apache-2.0 in their own repositories. Automagik Cloud is not part of this licence: it is a private, paid service.
