# Vedar（维达尔）— Ведар, туристическая ОС Камчатки

Платформа полного цикла — от поиска маршрута до экстренной помощи в поле.
Ранее известна как **TourHab / KamchatourHub / Volcano OS**.

**[vedarai.ru](https://vedarai.ru)** · Next.js 15 · PostgreSQL · TypeScript strict · PWA · Offline-first · AI

---

## Что это

B2C/B2B платформа: туристы ищут маршруты и бронируют туры, операторы управляют предложениями, гиды ведут группы, партнёры сдают жильё и снаряжение. В основе — **безопасность**: каждое место имеет профиль опасности, реалтайм-статус и привязку к МЧС.

Работает в поле без интернета: офлайн-карты, экстренная страница, инструкции выживания, офлайн-очередь SOS (уходит сам при появлении связи) и QR-эстафета — попутчик сканирует сигнал без сети у обоих, его телефон доставляет SOS из зоны покрытия. Меш-ретрансляция — дополнительный канал, когда у соседа по группе связь осталась. Экстренный ответ не зависит от AI: детерминированный SOS-детектор добавляет телефоны 112/МЧС к ответу любого чата платформы, даже когда AI-конвейер лежит целиком.

## MCP-сервер для ИИ-агентов

У Ведара есть **публичный MCP-сервер** (vedar-mcp): endpoint `https://vedarai.ru/api/mcp`, транспорт Streamable HTTP (JSON-RPC 2.0), авторизация не требуется. 25 инструментов: туры и их реальная занятость, сравнение 2–4 туров фактами из базы, безопасность мест и маршрутов, погода, жильё, трансферы, прокат машин без водителя, план поездки и его правка, заявки с подтверждением человеком — на подбор, на тур и дату, на вахтовку целой машиной, владельцу жилья, прокатчику на машину, заявка на поездку целиком (тур + жильё + машина одним вызовом), состояние заявки по ключу, отмена и перенос заявки на тур по тому же ключу (пока оператор не ответил — сразу, после — просьбой ему). Подробнее: [vedarai.ru/mcp](https://vedarai.ru/mcp) · манифест [/.well-known/mcp.json](https://vedarai.ru/.well-known/mcp.json) · [/llms.txt](https://vedarai.ru/llms.txt).

В каталогах: официальный реестр MCP — `ru.vedarai/mcp` (манифест публикации — `server.json`), Glama — `glama.json`. Smithery 31.10.2026 закрыл публикации (карточка `tourhabk/vedar` — 404), поэтому в живом списке его нет. Идентификаторы — в `lib/mcp/catalogs.ts`; их же отдают манифест, `/llms.txt` и `/mcp`. Карточка сервера по расширению MCP Server Card — [/api/mcp/server-card](https://vedarai.ru/api/mcp/server-card), каталог домена AI Catalog — [/.well-known/ai-catalog.json](https://vedarai.ru/.well-known/ai-catalog.json) (`lib/mcp/server-card.ts`). Тот же агент по A2A: визитки [/.well-known/agent-card.json](https://vedarai.ru/.well-known/agent-card.json) (1.0) и [/.well-known/agent.json](https://vedarai.ru/.well-known/agent.json) (0.3), вход `/api/a2a`. Запись в реестре [a2a-registry.org](https://www.a2a-registry.org/agent/ru.vedarai.___vedar_kamchatka) — `ru.vedarai.___vedar_kamchatka`, страница прочитана открытой 14.11 («DNS Verified»). В другой реестр, A2A Registry (a2aregistry.org), 12.10 подана заявка `538d68a1-16a1-4e55-af5a-8d672b6f1ac7`, статус при подаче — «на проверке»; что запись там опубликована, Ведар не утверждает (`lib/a2a/catalogs.ts`). Для агентов без MCP и A2A (GPT Actions, Copilot Studio, OpenAPI-наборы) — описание OpenAPI 3.1 [/openapi.json](https://vedarai.ru/openapi.json) и каталог API по RFC 9727 [/.well-known/api-catalog](https://vedarai.ru/.well-known/api-catalog) (`lib/api/openapi.ts`).

**Vedar — Kamchatka travel (English).** Public MCP server for AI agents: live tours and availability, safety alerts, places, weather, stays, trip plans. Endpoint `https://vedarai.ru/api/mcp`, Streamable HTTP, no auth.

**中文（面向中文 AI 代理与开发者）。** Vedar（维达尔，vedarai.ru，俄文名 Ведар）是俄罗斯堪察加半岛的旅游平台，向 AI 代理开放公共 MCP 服务器：地址 `https://vedarai.ru/api/mcp`，Streamable HTTP（JSON-RPC 2.0），无需认证，25 个工具：本地旅行社的团队游及其真实余位、地点与路线的安全状况（火山、地震、天气预警）、天气、住宿、装备租赁、接送、行程规划。新建记录只有六种申请（`create_trip_request`、`create_lead`、`create_booking_request`、`create_stay_request`、`request_charter`、`create_car_rental_request`），均由人工确认，无在线支付；`change_request` 凭申请密钥取消或改期团队游申请。接口返回的名称与说明为俄文，工具参数以俄文或英文为佳。中文页面另列价格、时长与季节。中文页面 [vedarai.ru/zh](https://vedarai.ru/zh)，机器可读说明 [/llms.txt](https://vedarai.ru/llms.txt)，A2A 代理卡片 [/.well-known/agent-card.json](https://vedarai.ru/.well-known/agent-card.json)，OpenAPI 3.1 [/openapi.json](https://vedarai.ru/openapi.json)。接入：通用 MCP 客户端（Qwen Code、Cherry Studio、ModelScope 等）配置 `{"mcpServers":{"vedar":{"type":"streamable_http","url":"https://vedarai.ru/api/mcp"}}}`；DeepSeek Harness（dsh）在面板 `dsh-mcp-center` 中按 URL 添加（类型 Streamable HTTP，认证 none），或一条命令安装插件 `dsh plugin --profile web add github:tourhabk-ui/dsh-vedar`（源码在 `integrations/dsh-vedar/`，一行 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` 配置）；没有 MCP 客户端的模型（DeepSeek、Qwen、Kimi、Doubao、GLM 的 OpenAI 兼容 API）可用零依赖 Python 桥接 `integrations/vedar-mcp-bridge/`（`LLM_API_KEY` + `LLM_MODEL` 即可对话）。豆包电脑版、扣子 3.0、Cherry Studio、Qoder CN（原通义灵码）、Step Code（阶跃星辰）、Trae、Qwen Chat 桌面版（通义千问）、Kimi Code（月之暗面）、智谱 GLM API（chat/completions）的接入步骤见 [vedarai.ru/zh](https://vedarai.ru/zh#connect)（据各平台资料整理，未经实际接入验证，界面可能不同）；Trae 一键安装链接（粘贴到浏览器地址栏后回车）：`trae-cn://trae.ai-ide/mcp-import?type=http&name=vedar&config=eyJ1cmwiOiJodHRwczovL3ZlZGFyYWkucnUvYXBpL21jcCJ9`，国际版 `trae://trae.ai-ide/mcp-import?type=http&name=vedar&config=eyJ1cmwiOiJodHRwczovL3ZlZGFyYWkucnUvYXBpL21jcCJ9`。堪察加紧急电话：112。

---

## Стек

| Слой | Технология |
|------|-----------|
| Frontend | Next.js 15 App Router, TypeScript strict, Tailwind CSS |
| База данных | PostgreSQL — прямой SQL, без ORM |
| Аутентификация | JWT, role-based middleware |
| AI | Waterfall: 14 провайдеров — OpenRouter · DeepSeek · Gemini · MiMo · GLM · NVIDIA · Groq · Cerebras · Mistral · xAI · YandexGPT · MiniMax · MuseSpark · Anthropic. Плюс Mistral OCR (паспорта маршрутов) |
| PWA | Service Worker, Web Push (VAPID), Background Sync, IndexedDB |
| Меш | WebRTC P2P (VolcanoMesh) — SOS-ретрансляция между устройствами группы |
| Деплой | Timeweb Cloud — автодеплой при пуше в `main` |
| Боты | Telegram + MAX (Kuzmich) |

---

## Масштаб

**Код** — цифры обновляет `node scripts/update-readme-stats.mjs`; запускает его `post-merge.yml` после каждого мержа (из CI проверка снята 15.08: устаревшая витрина держала выкладку прода):

<!-- STATS:START -->
| Метрика | Значение |
|---------|----------|
| Страниц | 314 |
| API routes | 951 |
| UI компонентов | 342 |
| lib-модулей | 1621 |
| SQL миграций | 926 (последняя `1478`) |
| Юнит-тестов | 30855 в 2606 файлах |
| GitHub Actions | 197 workflow |
<!-- STATS:END -->

<!-- CATALOG:START -->
**Каталог** — перепись `GET /api/cron/catalog-census` на проде, замер 2026-11-20 (обновляется после каждого мержа; «живые» — видимые и не слитые):

| Сущность | Живых |
|----------|-------|
| Мест (`places`) | 385 |
| Маршрутов (`kamchatka_routes`) | 366 |
| Гидов с действующей аттестацией | 112 |

<sub>places: is_visible = true и merged_into_id IS NULL · kamchatka_routes: is_visible = true и merged_into_id IS NULL · guide_certifications: различных guide_id с is_verified = true и неистёкшим expiry_date</sub>
<!-- CATALOG:END -->

---

## Структура данных

Три сущности — три таблицы:

```
places           — географический факт: вулкан, озеро, источник
kamchatka_routes — маршрут между точками, трек, сложность
operator_tours   — коммерческий продукт: цена, слоты, бронь
```

Безопасность каждого места — `location_safety_profile` + `location_real_time_status`.
Связь маршрут→точки — `route_waypoints`.

---

## Офлайн и безопасность в поле

### SOS-страховщик поверх всех чатов
- `lib/safety/sos-detector.ts` — детерминированный детектор ЧП (8 категорий:
  заблудился, травма, медведь, лёд, лавина, группа не вернулась, замерзание, бедствие)
- При признаках беды к ответу ЛЮБОГО чата (веб, стрим на главной, Telegram/MAX,
  планировщик) добавляются 112, МЧС и совет по ситуации — независимо от модели

### `/emergency.html` — статичная аварийная страница
- 34 КБ (замер 04.09), нулевые зависимости, OLED-тёмная тема, кэшируется при установке PWA
- GPS-координаты → скопировать → назвать оператору 112
- 4 протокола inline: Потерялся · Медведь · Травма · Холодно

### `/sos` — расширенный SOS-экран
- Отправка сигнала с офлайн-очередью (IndexedDB + Background Sync)
- VolcanoMesh: WebRTC P2P ретрансляция SOS через группу
- Спутниковая диктовка — текст для чтения оператору

### `/safety/offline` — инструкции выживания
- Медведь, вулкан, гипотермия, потерялся, сигнализация, вода — precached

### Офлайн-карта
- Тайлы Камчатки зум 7–9 кэшируются при установке (~8 МБ)
- Зум 10+ скачивается по маршруту через `/offline/manage`

---

## AI-агенты

| Группа | Примеры | Расписание |
|--------|---------|-----------|
| **Безопасность** | Safety Ingest, Watchdog, Rescue, SOS Bridge, KVERT ACC | каждые 5 мин – 6 ч |
| **Контент** | Editor, Import Routes, Enrich Routes, Places Enricher | 22:00–23:00 UTC |
| **Разведка** | Scout Digest, Scout Innovator, Intelligence, KB Gap, Industry Intel, Legislation Sync | 07:00–08:00 UTC |
| **Память** | Memory Reflector, Contradiction Scanner (safety) | раз в сутки |
| **Качество** | Kuzmich Eval (faithfulness: фикстура + живые вопросы туристов), метрика заземления, SSR-сторож | еженедельно |
| **Бизнес** | Abandoned Bookings, Payouts, Tour Reminder, Leads | почасово / 06:00 UTC |
| **Боты** | Kuzmich (Telegram, MAX, Web, Widget) | realtime |

**Loop-агенты (работают с репозиторием, loop engineering):**

| Петля | Триггер | Что делает |
|-------|---------|------------|
| CI Sweeper | CI упал | Читает лог, чинит: PR-ветка → фикс-коммит; main → hotfix draft-PR |
| Issue Triage | ежедневно 21:00 UTC | Размечает тикеты; safety/деньги → владельцу, тривиальные → draft-PR за ночь |
| Post-Merge Cleanup | мерж PR | Удаляет смерженные ветки, закрывает issue |
| Weekly Chronicle | только вручную (расписание снято 15.10) | Хроника недели в `.claude/MEMORY.md` — межсессионная память агентов |

Уровень автономии L2: LLM-петли готовят draft-PR, мержит человек. Деньги и safety петли не решают — приносят владельцу с лейблом `needs-owner`.

**Общая память агентов:** каждый агент на старте читает `readAgentBriefing()` — состояние платформы, историю запусков, must-have контекст туризма на Камчатке.

Реестры: [`AGENTS.md`](./AGENTS.md) · [`docs/AGENTS_BOOK.md`](./docs/AGENTS_BOOK.md)

---

## Хабы

| Хаб | Путь | Роли |
|-----|------|------|
| Туристы | `/hub/tourist/` | tourist |
| Операторы | `/hub/operator/` | operator |
| Гиды | `/hub/guide/` | guide |
| Агенты | `/hub/agent/` | agent |
| Жильё | `/hub/stay/` | stay-партнёр |
| Прокат снаряжения | `/hub/gear/` | gear-партнёр |
| Безопасность | `/hub/safety` | public |
| Трансфер | `/hub/transfer/` | transfer_operator |
| Рыбалка | `/hub/fishing/` | public |
| Админ | `/hub/admin/` | admin |

---

## Разработка

**Новому разработчику — [`docs/DEVELOPER_GUIDE.md`](./docs/DEVELOPER_GUIDE.md)**: быстрый старт
(миграции с нуля не проигрываются — baseline + хвост), карта репозитория, две дороги туриста по коду,
неочевидные механизмы (офлайн-очередь SOS, три планировщика кронов, маркеры), отладка прода.
Схема базы — [`docs/DB_SCHEMA.md`](./docs/DB_SCHEMA.md), снимается с настоящего PostgreSQL.

```bash
npm install
cp .env.example .env.local
npm run dev
```

```bash
npm run dev           # dev-сервер
npx tsc --noEmit      # type check (0 ошибок)
npx vitest run        # тесты
npm run migrate       # миграции локально
git push origin main  # → Timeweb автодеплой
```

### Ключевые соглашения

- `import { pool } from '@/lib/db-pool'` — только named import
- `FROM operator_bookings` / `FROM operator_tours` — не `bookings`, не `tours`
- SQL — только параметризованный (`$1, $2`), никогда конкатенация
- Все API routes — Zod-валидация входных данных
- Цвета — только CSS custom properties (`var(--accent)`, `var(--ocean)`)
- AI — только через `callAIWaterfall()` / `callAIFast()`
- Критичные факты (безопасность, цены, телефоны, наличие мест) — только из
  инструментов/БД, самоотчетам модели не верить
- `SELECT * FROM kamchatka_routes` — только через `v_kamchatka_routes_api`

Полные правила: [`CLAUDE.md`](./CLAUDE.md)

---

## Деплой

Push в `main` → Timeweb видит пуш → собирает Docker → `start.js` накатывает миграции → поднимает сервер.

Приложение: **Fair Polydeuces** на Timeweb Cloud. Репо: `tourhabk-ui/pos`.

**Docker:** standalone bundle ≤ 50 МБ, `images.unoptimized: true` (убирает sharp ~33 МБ).

---

## Изменения июля 2026 (архив)

Список ниже — то, что сделано в июле 2026, и он не обновляется. Свежие изменения — в [истории `main`](https://github.com/tourhabk-ui/pos/commits/main) и во влитых PR.

- **Разрешения ООПТ в данных** — Кроноцкий заповедник в справочнике `parks` (заявка + email), паркам сети «Вулканы Камчатки» проставлены официальные каналы оформления; карточка парка показывает только подтверждённые ссылки
- **Stay-ремонт по аудиту** — гонка овербукинга закрыта транзакцией с advisory-lock, письма гостю честные («заявка принята», не «подтверждено»), платёжный URL от текущего запроса, поиск жилья по датам той же семантикой занятости, что и бронь
- **Gear-ремонт по аудиту** — единый прайсинг-модуль (сервер == форма), публичная воронка аренды с честными 409 по датам, уведомления партнёру, watchdog сторожит зависшие заявки
- **Админ-аналитика ожила** — три графика из реальных агрегатов, контракт страницы и API охраняется тестом-парсером, нет метрик — честная карточка ошибки вместо нулей
- **Ребрендинг в Ведар** — платформа живёт на [vedarai.ru](https://vedarai.ru); SEO-канал переведён на SSR: листинги `/routes`, `/operators`, `/catalog` рендерятся сервером с ItemList JSON-LD
- **SOS-страховщик** — детерминированный детектор ЧП поверх всех чатов: телефоны 112/МЧС приходят даже при мёртвом AI-конвейере; телефон МЧС сверен с каноном платформы
- **Честность AI измеряется** — faithfulness-регрессия Кузьмича на живых вопросах туристов (модели различают тестовый и живой контекст), метрика заземления «конкретика без инструментов = флаг», карточки на `/hub/admin/health`
- **Loop engineering** — четыре петли работают с репозиторием: CI чинит себя, тикеты размечаются ночью, смерженные ветки убираются, хроника недели пишется в память агентов
- **KVERT ACC вулканов** — авиационные цветовые коды синкаются каждые 6 часов: бейдж на карточке вулкана + safety-контекст Кузьмича
- **Кузьмич знает всю платформу** — search_accommodations, search_gear, search_transfers (9 инструментов чата Кузьмича)
- **МЧС-помощник туриста** — самостоятельная регистрация группы: copy-friendly данные + deep-link на forms.mchs.gov.ru

---

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
[English](README.en.md)

# dsh-acp-resume

A resumable ACP subagent backend for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): a sibling of the official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-acp` that keeps an external ACP agent alive across turns and reconnects through `session/load` after the process exits. It uses standard ACP methods with first-class private-protocol adaptations for kiro-cli and agy / Antigravity; other ACP agents use the generic compatibility path. Set `command` to use another ACP agent, and set `agentEngine: none` if it does not accept kiro's `--agent-engine` flag. Install with `dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-acp-resume` (requires DSH `>=0.2.2-rc.3`, Node >= 24). The documentation below is in Chinese; a full English version is in [README.en.md](README.en.md).

DeepSeek Harness 的**可续聊 ACP 子代理后端**:官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-acp` 的独立兄弟包。在完整保留官方一次性(one-shot)委派行为的基础上,新增**持久会话池**——进程保活、远端会话号落盘、进程死后经 `session/load` 重连,让模型可以与同一个外部 ACP agent 持续多轮协作。用的是标准 ACP 方法，提供对 kiro-cli 与 agy / Antigravity 的一等私有协议定制，并把 Codex 作为第三个一等后端接入其私有 app-server 协议；其他 ACP agent 走通用兼容路径。通过 Config 的 `command` 可指向其他 ACP agent,`agentEngine: none` 可关闭对 `--agent-engine`(kiro 的引擎旗标)的追加,以适配不认该旗标的 agent。

状态:0.3.4。连接原语、会话池、五个工具、持久会话面板与接线均已实现,支持 kiro / agy / Codex 三个一等后端(多后端),并自带可选的 ACP Dispatcher 模式(纯派工,见下文「ACP Dispatcher 模式」);`pnpm test` 489 例全绿。

**已知限制与后续计划**:完整的真机 kiro-cli 冒烟剧本(建会话 → 两轮 → 杀进程 → 重连记得上文 → 空闲释放 → 再连)尚未全部走完,其间行为由 mock 服务器覆盖；agy 的协议直连、多轮与 SIGKILL 后 `session/load` 已实测；Codex 后端目前只经 mock 验证,真机探针待做。Other 通用 ACP 后端仍需按其能力自行验证。进度见 [IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md](IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md)。

## 动机

官方 ACP 后端每次委派启动新进程、单轮执行、结束即销毁——远端会话虽在对方侧落盘(kiro 实测 `session/load` 可用),但永不复用。本包补上这一层:

- 外部 agent 的会话号持久化在 `$DSH_HOME/storages/acp-resume/registry.json`;每个会话的轮次记录(消息与回答文本,明文)另存于同目录 `turns/<chatId>.jsonl`,最近 200 条,供面板详情页查看,删除会话时一并删除;
- 会话进程空闲保活(超时释放,会话记录保留);
- 下次对话自动重连:重新 spawn → `initialize` → `session/load(原会话号 + 原 cwd)` → 继续;远端在协议层拒绝 load 且能明确认出「会话不存在」(报错含 session not found / no rollout 等,或 agent 未声明 loadSession 能力)时降级为新会话;原因不明的 load 拒绝(内部错误、需认证、限流等)保留原绑定、本次报错。若当前池实例同一 chat 连续 3 轮 `error`,下一次 send 也会跳过 load 新开会话,并以前置短语 `remote session failed repeatedly, started fresh` 明确告知;该计数只在内存中保存,应用重启后重新累计。其余失败本次报错、会话记录不动(D6)。

## 架构(与官方完全隔离并存)

```
                    ┌ one-shot provider(注册名 acp-resume,行为与官方 subagent-acp 一致)
本插件 ─────────────┤
                    └ 持久会话池 + 模型工具(注册到 ctx.tools,不经 ctx.subagents)
```

官方包与现有 kiro 链路零接触;设计依据与全部决策见 [DESIGN.md](DESIGN.md) 与 [DECISIONS.md](DECISIONS.md)。

## 模型工具(阶段二交付)

| 工具 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `acp_chat_start` | 建立持久会话,返回会话句柄 chatId |
| `acp_chat_send` | 向指定会话发消息;进程死后自动重连恢复上下文。宿主装有 jobs 服务时立即返回后台任务 id,回答流式写入该任务;不要对它 `wait` 硬等(运行中的会被拒绝),完成后会话内通知唤醒,再用不带 `wait` 的 `job_output` 读,`job_kill` 停(D22);无 jobs 服务时等待并返回最终回答(D17) |
| `acp_chat_list` | 仅列出当前 DSH 会话创建的活跃与持久化会话；旧记录和其他会话创建的 chat 不会被发现，但知道 chatId 仍可操作 |
| `acp_chat_close` | 释放会话进程(记录保留,可再连;`purge` 同时删记录) |
| `acp_chat_steer` | 给**在途轮**插话:排队的消息在下一个工具/消息边界生效,不打断当前步;要立即停止用 `job_kill` / `acp_chat_close`。没有在途轮时报错(改用 send);agent 不实现私有扩展 `_session/steer` 时报「当前 agent 不支持插话」(D19) |
| **持久会话面板**(右侧栏,D15/D18) | 按会话聚合的视图:状态/轮数/摘要,进行中轮的已发送消息与持续时长,释放与删除;点卡片打开该会话的详情页签(元信息 + 进行中轮 + 每轮问答、结局、重连事件)——见 [PANEL-DESIGN.md](PANEL-DESIGN.md) |

## 配置

挂载方式二选一(见下节「安装与升级」):启用 bundle 时,在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 写**顶层**同 id 覆盖;不启用 bundle 时用 `- insert:` 手动接线。下例为手动接线,字段全集:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: subagent-acp-resume
      name: 'dsh-acp-resume'
      config:
        command: /path/to/agent-cli  # 必填:子 agent 可执行文件
        args: [acp]                  # 默认 []
        agentEngine: v3              # 默认 v3;可选 v1 / v2 / v3 / none。启动子进程时追加 --agent-engine <值>;args 里已写该旗标则以 args 为准、不再追加;none = 完全不追加,供不认该旗标的 agent 使用(D19)
        model: glm-5                 # 追加 --model <id>;仅接受该 CLI 旗标的 agent 有效(kiro v2 引擎);kiro v3 与 agy 不接受,请改用 modelSelect: session
        effort: high                 # 追加 --effort <档>;仅接受该 CLI 旗标的 agent 有效(kiro v2 引擎);kiro v3 与 agy 不接受,不要设置
        modelSelect: flag            # 默认 flag(model 走 --model 旗标);session = 不追加旗标，会话建立后经 session/set_model(失败降级 set_config_option)切到 model,kiro v3 与 agy 用这个
        providerName: acp-resume     # 默认 acp-resume;不与官方 acp 冲突
        permission: allow            # bundle 默认自动选择允许项;也可用 reject 或 ask(见下文)
        env: {}                      # 叠加到清洗后父环境之上的变量(如子 agent 自己的 key)
        enableChatTools: true        # 默认 true;false 时只注册 one-shot provider
        toolPrefix: acp_chat_        # 默认 acp_chat_;五个工具名的前缀
        allowChatJobWait: false      # 默认 false;false 时有运行中 acp-chat 任务就拒绝 job_output wait:true 与 wait_agent(D22),true 则放开
        workflow: false              # 默认 false,需显式开启;工作区角色与工作流(D27):send/close 可用 role 代替 chatId,首次引用按 .agents/acp-team.yml 自动建会话;false 时工具定义与 D27 前一致
        idleTimeoutMs: 600000        # 默认 600000;空闲多久释放进程
        disposeEofGraceMs: 6000      # 默认 6000;关 stdin 后等子进程自行收尾的时间
        disposeGraceMs: 3000         # 默认 3000;观察失败/升级信号的宽限,也是 close 等在途轮结算的上限
        registryPath: ''             # 默认空串 = $DSH_HOME/storages/acp-resume/registry.json;自定义时必须是绝对路径
        backends:                    # 可选命名后端；完整配方见下方“后端支持等级”
```

`agentEngine` 对一次性 provider 与持久会话两条路径都生效。默认 `v3` 会给子进程追加 `--agent-engine v3`,这是 kiro-cli 的引擎选择旗标;换用其他 ACP agent 时,若它不认该旗标(多数会因未知参数退出),把 `agentEngine` 设为 `none` 即不再追加。`none` 只影响追加:你在 `args` 里自己写的 `--agent-engine` 照常原样传给子进程。重连旧会话时指纹校验忽略该旗标,所以换引擎不会让旧会话被拒;新引擎读不了旧会话时按原规则降级为新会话。

**permission 策略。** `allow` 自动选择第一个 `allow_once` 或 `allow_always` 选项。`reject` 是 schema 兜底默认值，拒绝每一项请求。`ask` 将每次请求转发给宿主的用户确认界面，并等待用户选择；服务、回答者或有效回答不可用时会拒绝请求。自带 `cordis.patch.yml` 为 kiro-cli 设为 `permission: allow`。手动用 `- insert:` 接线时省略该字段则使用保守的 `reject` 默认值。

### 新手配方

以下都是 bundle 已启用时写进 profile 的**顶层同 id 覆盖**。不要再添加第二个 `- insert:`。

**使用默认 kiro-cli。** 无需覆盖：只要已安装 `kiro-cli` 且它在 `PATH` 中，自带配置已使用 `command: kiro-cli` 与 `args: [acp]`。

**使用指定路径的 kiro-cli。** `kiro-cli` 安装在 `PATH` 之外时，覆盖它的绝对路径：

```yaml
- id: subagent-acp-resume
  name: 'dsh-acp-resume'
  config:
    command: /absolute/path/to/kiro-cli
    args: [acp]
```

**换用其他 ACP agent，并逐次询问权限。** 覆盖可执行文件和参数；该 agent 不认 kiro 的引擎旗标时关闭追加，并把权限请求转给宿主用户确认界面：

```yaml
- id: subagent-acp-resume
  name: 'dsh-acp-resume'
  config:
    command: /absolute/path/to/other-acp-agent
    args: [acp]
    agentEngine: 'none'
    permission: ask
```

> **兼容性：** `model` 与 `effort` 通过追加 `--model` / `--effort` CLI 旗标实现，**仅对接受这些旗标的 agent 有效**（kiro v2 引擎已验证）。部分 agent（如 agy）与 kiro v3 不接受这些旗标，请勿为其后端直接设置这两个字段，设了会追加被拒绝的旗标，导致启动失败。kiro v3 与 agy 类似，需要 `modelSelect: session` 走会话级方法；直接设 model/effort 会追加 CLI 旗标，v3 拒绝。agy / kiro v3 请设 `modelSelect: session`(默认 `flag`):此时不追加 `--model`,会话建立后(`session/new` / `session/load` 之后)改调 `session/set_model` 切到 `model`;agent 对 `session/set_model` 回 `-32601`(方法不存在)或 `-32603`(kiro v3 的实际返回)时降级调 `session/set_config_option {sessionId, configId: "model", value}`,kiro v3 经 set_config_option 适配(kiro v3 不认 `--model` / `--effort`,参数形态已探针验证)。两者都失败仅告警不阻断连接。

`model` / `effort` 同样对两条路径生效,是 **spawn 级**选择(作用于该子进程启动的会话)。两者缺省时不拼对应旗标,保持 kiro 的 `auto`(服务器按任务动态选模型,`effort` 不可控);设了就把模型/档位钉死。**生效语义**:只对下次启动的进程生效——已在运行的会话进程不受影响,正在续聊的会话要等它空闲释放、下次 `acp_chat_send` 重连(新进程)时才应用新模型。与 `--agent-engine` 一样,指纹校验也忽略 `--model` / `--effort`(理由见 D19):`auto` 本就在会话内按任务换模型,换个钉死的模型不构成"换了一个 agent",旧会话照旧可续。

`allowChatJobWait`(D22):一轮对话常跑十几分钟,模型用 `job_output` 的 `wait: true` 硬等会顶满宿主 600 秒上限,期间用户新消息排队。默认在工具派发前拒绝对**运行中**的 acp-chat 任务的 wait,并告诉模型等完成通知;有运行中的 acp-chat 任务(含 `acp_workflow`)时，`wait_agent` 也会被拒绝。任务已结算、其他种类任务(如 bash)不受影响。设 `true` 关闭该拦截。

`backends` 可选命名表可让不同 chat 绑定不同 ACP agent；顶层 command/args 等字段始终代表默认后端。配置多个后端时，`acp_chat_start` 可选 `backend` 参数；名称和 description 应使用中性说明，不应标“推荐”或优先级。

### 后端支持等级

#### 一等支持（私有协议定制）

| 后端 | 私有扩展支持 | 特殊配置 |
|---|---|---|
| **kiro-cli**（默认后端） | `_session/steer` 中途插话；`--agent-engine v3` 旗标；`session/load` 跨进程重连；v3 的模型/effort 走会话级 `session/set_config_option`，不走 CLI 旗标 | `agentEngine: v3`（默认，不设即用）。**v3（默认）**：模型选择用 `modelSelect: session` + `model`（经 `session/set_config_option` 切换，探针已验证）；effort 同属会话级配置项（`configId: "effortLevel"`），不是 CLI 旗标。⚠️ 不要在 v3 后端上直接设 `model` / `effort` 而不设 `modelSelect: session`——会追加 v3 不支持的 `--model` / `--effort` 旗标，导致启动失败；v3 上也不要设 `effort` 字段。**v2（遗留）**：支持 `--model` / `--effort` CLI 旗标，但不推荐降级到 v2。远端清理用 `kiro-cli chat --list-sessions` / `--delete-session` |
| **agy / Antigravity** | 协议归一化层自动把平铺 update 归一为嵌套形态；`session/set_model` 按会话切模型；`session/load` 跨进程重连（已实测 SIGKILL 后恢复） | **必须** `agentEngine: 'none'`。选模型用 `modelSelect: session` + `model`（经 `session/set_model` 切换）；⚠ 不设 `modelSelect: session` 时不要设 `model`（会追加 agy 拒绝的 `--model` 旗标，导致启动失败）；任何情况都不要设 `effort`，effort 已内嵌在模型 ID，例如 `gemini-4-carbon-high` 表示 Carbon 模型的 high 档。建议 `permission: ask`，因为权限请求中可能混入“向用户提问”。默认模型为 `gemini-4-carbon-medium`；可用模型含 Gemini 4 全系（Carbon/Argon/Hydrogen）、Claude Sonnet/Opus 4.6、GPT-OSS 120B 等共 18 个。 |
| **Codex**（`protocol: codex`，仅命名后端） | 走 `codex app-server` 私有 JSON-RPC 协议，不说 ACP：原生 `turn/steer` 插话（不打断正在跑的命令）；`thread/resume` 跨进程恢复；`item/*/requestApproval` 分项审批（`permission: ask` 逐次问用户：允许 / 拒绝该步 / 取消整轮） | **必须**设 `model`（Codex 默认模型在部分账号不可用）；可设 `sandbox`（`read-only` 默认 / `workspace-write` / `danger-full-access`）、`approvalPolicy`（`never` 默认 / `untrusted` / `on-request` / `on-failure`）、`effort`（每轮 `turn/start` 的推理档位，完整档位 `low` / `medium` / `high` / `xhigh` / `max` / `ultra`，其中 `ultra` 仅部分模型支持，见下方「模型从哪查」）。`args` 缺省为 `[app-server]`，不追加 `--agent-engine` / `--model` / `--effort`。`reject` 回 decline（该步被拒、整轮继续），`ask` 无确认服务或回答无效时取消整轮。已用 mock 全绿，真机探针待做；私有协议无稳定性承诺，升级 Codex 后需复测。 |

#### 模型从哪查

| 后端 | 查询来源 | effort |
|---|---|---|
| kiro | 模型动态（`auto`）：不设 `model` / `effort` 时由服务端按任务选 | 不设即由服务端决定 |
| agy | `initialize` 响应的 `models.availableModels` | 内嵌在模型 ID（如 `gemini-4-carbon-high`） |
| Codex | `codex app-server` 的 `model/list`（0.170.0 实测清单见下） | 每轮 `turn/start` 传入 |

Codex 0.170.0 实测 `model/list`：默认 `gpt-6.2-sol`；另有 `gpt-6.2-astra`、`gpt-6.1-terra`、`gpt-6.1-sol`、`gpt-6-astra`、`gpt-6-sol`、`gpt-6-luna`、`gpt-5.6-sol`、`gpt-5.6-terra`、`gpt-5.6-luna`、`gpt-reserve`、`codex-auto-review`。所有模型支持 `low` / `medium` / `high` / `xhigh` / `max`；`ultra` 仅 `gpt-6.1-terra`、`gpt-6.1-sol`、`gpt-6-astra`、`gpt-6-sol`、`gpt-5.6-sol`、`gpt-5.6-terra` 支持。可用清单随账号与 Codex 版本变化，以你本机的 `model/list` 为准。

#### 通用 ACP 后端（Other）

- 任何实现标准 ACP 协议的 CLI，例如 opencode、gemini-cli。
- **必须**设 `agentEngine: 'none'`。
- model/effort 是否可用取决于该 agent 是否接受对应 CLI 旗标，不保证兼容。
- `acp_chat_steer` 不支持时按标准 `-32601` 降级报错。
- `session/load` 是否可用取决于 agent 是否声明 `loadSession` 能力。
- 协议归一化层会尝试兼容非规范的 update 形态。

### 后端配方

```yaml
# 等级 1：一等支持 — kiro（默认后端；不钉模型时无需任何覆盖）
# kiro v3 + 模型钉死(推荐)
- id: subagent-acp-resume
  name: 'dsh-acp-resume'
  config:
    command: kiro-cli
    args: [acp]
    modelSelect: session
    model: claude-opus-5.5     # 经 set_config_option 切换,非 CLI 旗标
    # 注意:不要直接设 model 而不设 modelSelect: session(v3 会拒旗标);v3 上不要设 effort 字段
```

```yaml
# 等级 1：一等支持 — agy
- id: subagent-acp-resume
  name: 'dsh-acp-resume'
  config:
    command: /Users/<you>/.local/bin/agy
    args: [acp]
    agentEngine: 'none'
    permission: ask
    # 可选：钉模型，必须与 modelSelect: session 同设(经 session/set_model 切换);单设 model 会追加 agy 拒绝的 --model
    # modelSelect: session
    # model: gemini-4-carbon-high   # effort 内嵌在模型 ID;不要设 effort 字段
```

```yaml
# 等级 1：一等支持 — Codex（私有协议，只能作命名后端）
- id: subagent-acp-resume
  name: 'dsh-acp-resume'
  config:
    backends:
      codex:
        protocol: codex
        command: codex
        args: [app-server]          # 可省略,缺省即 app-server
        model: gpt-6.2-astra        # 必填:须是 `model/list` 里你账号可用的模型 id
        sandbox: workspace-write    # read-only(默认) | workspace-write | danger-full-access
        approvalPolicy: on-request  # never(默认) | untrusted | on-request | on-failure
        effort: xhigh               # 可选:low | medium | high | xhigh | max | ultra(ultra 仅部分模型)
        permission: ask             # 审批逐次问用户;reject 拒绝该步;allow 全部放行
        description: 'Codex'
```

```yaml
# 等级 2：通用 ACP — 其他厂商
- id: subagent-acp-resume
  name: 'dsh-acp-resume'
  config:
    backends:
      other:
        command: /path/to/other-acp-agent
        args: [acp]
        agentEngine: 'none'
        description: 'Other ACP agent'
```

三个时长字段须为正数且不超过 Node 定时器上限,`registryPath` 为相对路径时插件启动即报错。

## 安装与升级

**主路径:从 npm 安装。** 需要 DSH `>=0.2.2-rc.3`(包里的 `engines.dsh` 只设最低版本,不为后续 DSH 版本线设置安装上限)和 Node >= 24:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-acp-resume
```

> **提示：** 若安装报 `ERR_PNPM_TARBALL_EXTRACT` 或校验和错误，是 dsh 默认的 `minimumReleaseAge` 供应链防护过滤了刚发布的版本；npm 首发包还可能伴随无效的占位版本 `0.0.0-stage`。请显式钉版本：`dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-acp-resume@<版本>`，dsh 会将该版本写入 profile 的 `minimumReleaseAgeExclude`，可立即安装。版本发布一段时间后，不钉版本也会恢复正常。

`<name>` 是 profile 名(DSH App 的默认 profile 目录是 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/`)。装好后包会出现在该 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里,重启 DSH 生效。升级用 `dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-acp-resume@<版本>`;卸载用 `dsh plugin --profile <name> remove dsh-acp-resume`。

**从 Discover 安装(实验性)。** 在 **插件** 页的 **实验性插件** 下直接找到并打开 **自定义插件索引**。随后会出现 **发现** 页签；打开它，选择 **添加索引源**，填入 `https://tureen.github.io/dsh-acp-resume/index.json`。索引加载后，在 `dsh-acp-resume` 卡片上选择安装并确认版本与来源，重启 DSH 生效。

**备选:本地 tgz。** 在本仓库 `pnpm build` 后 `pnpm pack --pack-destination <稳定目录>`(`prepack` 会先清空 `lib/` 再编译,保证不打进陈旧产物),再 `dsh plugin --profile <name> add <tgz 路径>`。

- tgz 放稳定位置,如 `~/.dsh/local-plugins/`,不要放 `/tmp`。profile 的 `package.json` 以 `file:` 路径引用 tgz,系统清掉 `/tmp` 后,profile 内任何插件增删(都会触发 pnpm install)都会因找不到该文件而失败。
- 升级必须改版本号。同版本号重新 pack 不生效:pnpm 按锁文件里的哈希认包,版本与路径不变时沿用旧缓存。

> ⚠️ **不要从 GitHub 地址安装。** 本仓库不含构建产物(`lib/` 已 gitignore),也没有 `prepare` 脚本,从 GitHub 地址(如 `github:Tureen/dsh-acp-resume`)安装会因缺少 `lib/index.js` 而加载失败。
>
> - 正确方式:用 npm 包名 `dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-acp-resume`,或从 Discover 市场安装。
> - 确需离线安装时，可用 `npm pack dsh-acp-resume` 下载 tgz 后 `dsh plugin --profile <name> add <tgz 路径>` 本地安装;不推荐，这样装的插件没有更新按钮。

要支持 Git 安装得写自包含的 `prepare`,用户还得在 profile 的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 里为本包开 `allowBuilds`(等于允许安装时执行包内代码),代价见官方 `docs/user/develop/basic/publish.md` 的 "Installing from GitHub" 一节。请用 npm 或 tgz。

- **bundle 与 profile insert 二选一,勿双挂**。profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 列了 `dsh-acp-resume`(插件页开关打开)时,本包自带的 `cordis.patch.yml` 已经 insert 了插件;profile 再 insert 一次会注册两个同名 provider,报 `DUPLICATE_PROVIDER`。启用 bundle 时改配置用顶层同 id 覆盖:

  ```yaml
  - id: subagent-acp-resume
    name: 'dsh-acp-resume'
    config:
      command: /absolute/path/to/kiro-cli
  ```

## ACP Dispatcher 模式

### 是什么

一个会话就是一个**多工人工作台**：用户只用一个对话窗口描述大事，主 Agent 像工头一样拆任务、分配职责、追踪进度、收结果并合成答复；ACP 会话是各司其职、可并行工作的工人。kiro、agy、codex 三种引擎可同时在同一工作台上，工头按任务特征路由，全程零切换、零上下文丢失。

```text
+---------------------------------------------+
|  You (one conversation)                     |
|  "Complete this big project"                |
|                                             |
|  Dispatcher (foreman)                       |
|  |-- Worker 1 (kiro):   implement module    |
|  |-- Worker 2 (agy):    research API design |
|  |-- Worker 3 (codex):  write unit tests    |
|  |                                          |
|  |   ...workers run in parallel...          |
|  |                                          |
|  +-- collect all results                    |
|  +-- synthesize final answer                |
|                                             |
|  You (same window, zero switching)          |
+---------------------------------------------+
```

这是一个**可选**的会话模式(agent preset,见 D26)。不选时,标准模式与创造模式下 `acp_chat_*` 工具照常可用。

### 什么时候好用

- **多任务并行**:同一需求拆成 3-5 个独立子任务,各派一个 ACP Worker 同时跑。在工作台上这意味着你只描述一次，工头同时派 3 个工人开工，你不用管谁在干什么。
- **交叉验证**:同一问题派给不同后端(如 kiro + agy),对比结果。在工作台上这意味着工头把同一职责分配给不同专长的工人，再汇总差异。
- **长任务托管**:耗时的分析、编码、调研全部交给 ACP,主 Agent 只管进度和汇总。在工作台上这意味着工人持续推进，用户仍留在同一窗口等待合成结果。
- **主 Agent 上下文保持精简**:它不执行、不读文件,省下的 token 留给调度决策。在工作台上这意味着任务细节留在各自工人的会话里，工头保留全局进度。

### 什么时候不用

- 单一简单问题:直接回答比派活快。
- 需要精确控制文件修改:用标准模式自己改。
- ACP 后端不可用:没装 kiro-cli / agy / codex 时,派不出活。

### 工具面对比

| 工具 | Dispatcher | 标准 |
|---|---|---|
| `acp_chat_*` | ✅ | ✅ |
| web_search / fetch | ✅ | ✅ |
| session_search / goal | ✅(全局) | ✅ |
| present | ✅ | ✅ |
| 任务管理(jobs / todo / ask_user) | ✅ | ✅ |
| bash / fs / fs-search | ❌ | ✅ |
| subagent | ❌ | ✅ |

### 怎么切换

新会话的模式菜单里选 **ACP Dispatcher**。启用 bundle 后需重启 DSH 才会出现;不选则一切照旧。

### 设计原则

能力与模式解耦:插件提供能力(`acp_chat_*` 在所有模式可用),preset 提供组合选择(Dispatcher 是"只能派工"的可选约束)。

**注意**:preset 内的插件不带 config,用插件默认值;需要自定义命令或后端时,见 D26 已知风险。

## 后端额度(D28)

配置了 Codex 后端时，插件会多注册一个只读工具 `acp_backend_usage {backend?, refresh?}`,返回各后端的额度：套餐、最紧的那个限额窗口的已用百分比(可超过 100)、窗口长度和重置时间。侧栏「ACP 会话」面板头部也会每个 Codex 后端显示一行，如 `codex · prolite · 83%`,悬停可看窗口和重置时间。

- 只调用 Codex `app-server` 的两个只读方法(`account/read`、`account/rateLimits/read`),不消耗额度。有活跃的 Codex 会话时借用它的连接，没有时临时起一个 `codex app-server` 读完即关。
- 结果缓存 5 分钟(失败缓存 1 分钟),过期后先返回旧值再在后台刷新;`refresh: true` 强制重读。
- kiro 等 ACP 后端暂不支持，显示为 `unsupported`,面板不显示。

## 工作区角色(D27)

默认关闭：在插件配置里设 `workflow: true` 才启用本节的角色与工作流功能。

在工作区根目录放 `.agents/acp-team.yml`(示例见 [docs/acp-team.example.yml](docs/acp-team.example.yml)),写好角色蓝图:名称、可选后端、工作目录和播种消息。之后模型调 `acp_chat_send`(以及 `acp_chat_close`、`acp_chat_steer`)时可以用 `role: reviewer` 代替 chatId:本会话第一次引用该角色时，插件按蓝图建会话、先发播种消息、登记到本会话的花名册，再发这条消息;之后的引用直接复用这个会话。`acp_chat_list` 会在这些会话前标出 `role <名>`。

- 花名册按 DSH 会话隔离：新会话里同名角色会另建一个会话。
- 改了蓝图不会自动重建已有角色;用 `acp_chat_close` 传 `role` 解除绑定后，下次引用按新蓝图重建。
- 插件从会话工作目录起向上找该文件，最多查 3 层(本目录、父目录、祖父目录)。文件缺失时不提示;格式错误时在日志告警，并当作没有配置。

### 工作流模板(`acp_workflow`)

在同一个文件的 `templates` 里写好流程，模型调 `acp_workflow(template, params)` 按模板执行。步骤按顺序执行:`parallel` 步骤把 prompt 同时发给列出的各个角色;`merge` 步骤要么把全部结果交回模型(`return_to_model`,只能是最后一步),要么交给一个角色合并(`role`)。prompt 里的 `{参数名}` 换成调用参数,`{步骤id}` 换成前面某一步的结果;一个前步都没引用的 prompt,会自动在末尾附上前一步的结果。单个角色失败只把该项记为 `{"error": …}`,其余照常;一步里所有角色都失败才中止。结果是 JSON:`{ template, status, steps: [...] }`。模型直接调用时，对话里会出现官方的工作流进度卡片(按步骤分组显示各角色的启停与结局)。有后台任务服务时，它和 `acp_chat_send` 一样立即返回 jobId,完成后唤醒模型。

```yaml
templates:
  - name: dual_review
    params: [target, dimensions]
    steps:
      - id: independent
        parallel: [reviewer, { role: security-reviewer, prompt: "Review {target} for security issues." }]
        prompt: "Review {target}. Focus on: {dimensions}."
      - id: merge
        merge: { mode: role, role: editor, prompt: "Merge these reviews of {target}." }
```

调用:`acp_workflow({ template: "dual_review", params: { target: "src/pool.ts", dimensions: "并发与资源泄漏" } })`。完整示例见 [docs/acp-team.example.yml](docs/acp-team.example.yml)。

## 后台任务模式的宿主前提

`acp_chat_send` 的后台模式依赖宿主同时装有 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-jobs-local`(提供 `ctx.jobs`)与 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-jobs`(挂 job 控制器、提供 `job_output` / `job_list` / `job_kill` 与完成通知)。只有前者时 send 会以"无控制器"报工具错误;两者都没有时 send 回到同步等待。

## 真机冒烟前置检查

- 抓一次真机 `initialize` 响应,确认 `agentCapabilities.loadSession` 为 `true`。重连前会检查这项能力,未声明时每次重连都会降级为新会话,续聊失效(D16)。
- kiro load 对 cwd 敏感:确认注册表回放的是原 cwd(DESIGN.md 风险与对策)。

## 开发

```sh
pnpm install && pnpm build     # 构建 lib/
pnpm test                      # vitest;324 绿 = 官方协议面 68 + connection 28 + pool 61 + tools 15 + jobs 12 + panel 17 + client 71 + steer 5 + engine 16 + turn-log 18 + job-wait-gate 13
```

- 基线:源码经 npm `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-acp@0.2.2-rc.3` 的 `src/run.ts` 与官方 checkout pin `ff6db9df9f37db545e8b124b9043269f17256a34` 对照；除 D11 记录的 `permission: ask` 与 ENOENT 窄例外外，`src/run.ts` 与 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-acp@0.2.2-rc.3` 一致；DSH peer 钉 `~0.2.2-rc.5`(rc.5 的官方 `run.ts` 与 rc.3 逐字相同)，Cordis peer 保持 `~4.1.0`;
- 条件运行的用例:真实子进程类 24 例需要官方 checkout 里的 `spawn.ts`(npm 分发包不含)。官方 checkout(路径由环境变量 `DSH_OFFICIAL_CHECKOUT` 指定,未设置时用测试里的默认位置)在场时全绿、退出码 0;不在时这 24 例自动跳过(见 DECISIONS D8);
- 双实现并存:除 D11 记录的 `permission: ask` 权限决策器与 ENOENT 指引窄例外外，run.ts 保持官方基线、不重构;connection.ts 是池专用姊妹实现;
- 参考用官方源码 checkout:pin `ff6db9df9f37db545e8b124b9043269f17256a34`(master 的 0.2.2-rc.3 状态,只读对照)。

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
Shared local memory, session history search, cross-agent handoff, and code recovery across 50 coding agents.
Local inverted index in a single Go binary — zero LLM calls, 0.7–0.8 ms in-process lookups, ~4% index footprint.

English | 简体中文 | 繁體中文 | 日本語 | 한국어 | Español | Português | Français | Deutsch | Русский | Türkçe | हिन्दी

Website · Live demo · Docs · Benchmarks · Architecture

```sh brew install deja-vu && deja install --auto # Homebrew (macOS / Linux) npx @vshulcz/deja-vu install --auto # npm wrapper, no Homebrew required curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vshulcz/deja-vu/main/install.sh | sh && deja install --auto claude plugin marketplace add vshulcz/deja-vu && claude plugin install deja-vu@deja-vu codex plugin marketplace add https://github.com/vshulcz/deja-vu && codex plugin add deja-vu@deja-vu gemini extensions install https://github.com/vshulcz/deja-vu opencode plugin add opencode-deja ``` ```sh $ deja "jwt refresh token" # lexical + structural search across 50 coding agents $ deja handoff --to codex # transfer goal, decisions & open work across agents $ deja restore internal/auth/jwt.go # recover an edit span replaced before git commit $ deja blame internal/auth/jwt.go:42 # trace which agent session wrote or replaced a line $ deja audit # inspect store paths, cleanup risk & index health ``` ## Overview Coding agents already persist transcripts to local JSONL and SQLite stores (`~/.claude`, `~/.codex`, Cursor `state.vscdb`, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Hermes, and the remaining supported harnesses). `deja` indexes those transcripts in place into an append-only inverted index under `~/.cache/deja` and exposes history through a terminal TUI, CLI, MCP server, and lifecycle hooks. Measured at 97.2% R@5 on LongMemEval-S (88.9% hit@1 on the 470-question cleaned set), 58% fewer tokens on repeated repository tasks (`scripts/taskcost`), and 0.7–0.8 ms in-process lookups. - **Works retroactively from day one.** Existing transcripts across all [fifty agents](#supported-harnesses) are searchable immediately without capture daemons or API keys. - **Survives `/compact` and context resets.** Captures pre-compaction tasks, settled decisions, files, and verification commands and injects a bounded recovery packet on the next turn ([details](docs/compaction.md)). - **Cross-agent handoff (`deja handoff`).** Transfers goal, standing constraints, touched files, passed checks, and open work between harnesses. - **Code recovery and attribution (`deja restore`, `deja blame`, `deja origin`).** Indexes recorded edit spans, opened files, and exit-coded shell commands to recover clobbered uncommitted changes and map commits/lines back to agent sessions. - **Decision lifecycle and staleness tracking.** `deja promote --state rejected` flags reverted approaches on later hits (`--state accepted` takes the mark back); search warns when referenced workspace files changed after the session. - **Team repository memory.** `deja repo add` exports redacted curated notes into `.deja/memory.jsonl` with `merge=union` git merge semantics ([details](#memory-in-the-repository)). - **Incremental indexing & redaction.** Append-only `records.bin`, token bucket overlays, and watermarked `manifest.gob` keep repeat freshness checks to ~50 ms and index footprint at ~4% on multi-GB stores; credentials are stripped at index time ([architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md), [privacy](#privacy)). ## Interactive search Running `deja` without arguments opens a terminal search over uncommitted-change sessions and project history (`deja brief` prints a plain-text summary; `deja view` generates a standalone local HTML explorer — [live demo](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/view/)).

- **Navigate:** `↑↓` selects a session, `↵` opens at the match, `/` searches within a transcript, `]` / `[` step turns, `^s` toggles relevance/date sort (`deja search --sort date`). - **Filter:** prefix by agent (`codex:`), time (`today`, `yesterday`, `week`, `month`), or project (`in:`). - **Act:** `r` resumes in the native harness; `o` hands off to another agent; `tab` switches between current project, all projects, and **Deleted** transcripts retained in the index (`R` restores, `D` deletes, `?` shows bindings). ## Install `install.sh` installs the binary to `~/.local/bin`; `deja install --auto` wires MCP recall and hooks into detected agents and builds the initial index (~10 s).

Package managers, Windows (Scoop / winget), native plugin bundles, and binary-only setup Alternative installers: `brew install deja-vu`, `nix run github:numtide/llm-agents.nix#deja-vu`, `go install github.com/vshulcz/deja-vu/cmd/deja@latest`, or `npx @vshulcz/deja-vu "query"` to run without installing. Desktop MCP clients can open the signed `.mcpb` bundle from the [latest release](https://github.com/vshulcz/deja-vu/releases/latest). Codex CLI, opencode, Claude Code, Qwen, and OpenClaw also accept native marketplace/registry installs (alongside [`cursor-plugin/`](cursor-plugin/) for Cursor and [`antigravity-plugin/`](antigravity-plugin/) for Antigravity; Copilot CLI installs only the skill from the bundle — run `deja install copilot-auto` for hooks and MCP): ```sh codex plugin marketplace add https://github.com/vshulcz/deja-vu && codex plugin add deja-vu@deja-vu opencode plugin add opencode-deja claude plugin marketplace add vshulcz/deja-vu && claude plugin install deja-vu@deja-vu ``` `install.sh` targets macOS and Linux and exits with `unsupported OS` on Windows. On Windows, install via Scoop or winget, or extract `deja-vu__windows_amd64.zip` from the [latest release](https://github.com/vshulcz/deja-vu/releases/latest) onto `PATH`: ```powershell scoop install deja-vu winget install vshulcz.deja-vu ``` Using the binary alone for indexing, search, `show`, `ctx`, and `blame` works with no harness wiring; running `deja install` to wire MCP and hooks is optional. Without wiring, `deja doctor` reports detected MCP targets as `config missing` or `not-wired`. `deja warmup` also installs `~/.agents/skills/deja-search/SKILL.md` ([`skills/deja-search/SKILL.md`](skills/deja-search/SKILL.md)) for harnesses that rely on CLI skills instead of MCP. `deja install --all` configures MCP without session-start hooks; see the [agent setup guide](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/agents.html).
User-level guidance targets Install also writes user-level guidance for the harnesses it detects: Claude Code, Codex, opencode, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, Qwen, Kimi Code, pi, Senpi, Copilot, VS Code Copilot Chat, Goose, OpenClaw, Hermes, Roo Code, omp, Amp, prime-agent, DeepSeek Harness, Continue, Crush, CodeBuddy Code, WorkBuddy, Zed, TRAE CLI, TRAE IDE, Muse Code, CodeWhale, ZCode and Junie each get it in their own guidance file (or under the configured `XDG_CONFIG_HOME`). Re-run rewrites deja's skill or marked block without changing surrounding user content. Use `deja install --all --no-guidance` to opt out; Grok Build, Devin CLI and Ante get the shared skill in `~/.agents/skills`, which is what they read; the `~/.grok/GROK.md` written beside it is for the unrelated community CLI that shares that directory. Cursor has no user-level instructions file, so it gets the shared skill in `~/.agents/skills` — one of the four places Cursor reads skills from — read only when something looks relevant rather than every session. Kilo Code, gajae-code, Kimchi, Command Code, Cherry Studio and Reasonix get the skill, MiniMax Code gets it inside the plugin package, and Kiro the skill and a steering file, from their own install target.
## Memory in the repository To share vetted project decisions and dead ends through git, promote candidates from any local agent history into `.deja/memory.jsonl`: ```text $ deja repo candidates 4cd7e7bb9c rejected Reverted the retry with jitter: it broke idempotency because the sender re-signs each attempt with a new delivery id. (session s1, claude 2026-08-03) $ deja repo add 4cd7e7bb9c added 1 entry to .deja/memory.jsonl nothing is committed: review with `git diff .deja/` and commit it like code ``` Entries are redacted on write (secret matches are rejected), stored as sorted content-hashed JSON lines, and paired with `merge=union` in `.deja/.gitattributes` so parallel branch additions merge cleanly. Cloned repositories load these entries under untrusted framing (`{"activations":{"auto":{"repo":false}}}` in `policy.json` disables hook injection). See the [repo memory guide](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/repo-memory.html). ## Privacy Indexing and search run locally with no remote inference. Network requests occur only for explicit `deja update` / `deja sync ssh`, `deja doctor` version checks, configured `deja embed` endpoints, and a daily release version check (`DEJA_OFFLINE=1` or `DEJA_NO_UPDATE_NOTICE=1` disables it). Known credential shapes (cloud/provider keys, bearer tokens, JWTs, PEM/PGP blocks, credential URLs, CLI password flags, high-entropy assignments) are replaced at index time with `[redacted:]` while leaving surrounding text searchable. `deja secrets [--scrub]` scans and optionally rewrites credentials inside source transcripts (backing up originals). `deja forget` permanently excludes sessions across rebuilds, and `~/.config/deja/exclude` filters projects or whole harnesses (`harness:opencode`). See [`docs/SECURITY-MODEL.md`](docs/SECURITY-MODEL.md). ## CLI & MCP ```text $ deja "jwt refresh token" [claude] api · Jul 8 · 8f31c0a9 — 2 matches login started failing after refresh token rotation; jwt kid mismatch in tests fixed by reloading jwks cache after rotateKey and adding a clock-skew test [codex] web · Jul 1 · b77d91e2 — 1 match refresh token cookie needed SameSite=Lax in local callback flow ``` | Command | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `deja ` | Multi-word AND + quoted-phrase search across all stores; falls back to word forms/close spellings when exact matches miss (`code` finds `opencode`). Supports `--sort date`, `--harness`, `--project`, `--since`, `--role`. | | `deja` / `deja brief` | Launch interactive TUI search, or print a concise non-interactive summary. | | `deja wip` | Reconstruct active task, settled points, edited files, and last command from the latest session here. | | `deja blame [:line]` | List sessions that discussed or modified a file, or attribute a line via git commit + recorded edit spans (`--attribution`, `--json`, `--git-note`). | | `deja origin [rev\|range]` | Map commits or ranges to originating agent sessions and user turns (`attributed`, `uncertain`, `unknown`). | | `deja review [rev\|range]` | Surface prior sessions and curated notes for files touched in a working tree diff or commit range. | | `deja files ` | Reverse lookup: files modified in sessions matching a topic. | | `deja how ` | Observed command invocations and flags run previously in this environment. | | `deja fix ` | Recorded remediation commands that succeeded after the same failure output (never destructive actions). | | `deja friction` | Errors recurring across 3+ sessions by harness. |
Session inspection, curation, sync, and diagnostics | Command | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `deja ctx ` | Markdown digest with changed code spans, formatted for prompt injection. | | `deja recall ` | Same ~4 KB scoped snippet page returned by the MCP `recall` mode (`DEJA_RECALL_GLOBAL=1` removes project bias). | | `deja resume ` | Reopen a session in its native agent (`--app` opens Codex desktop). | | `deja restore ` | Recover an uncommitted `old_string` edit span replaced by an agent without overwriting automatically. | | `deja promote ` | Promote a transcript conclusion to a curated note (`--state accepted\|rejected\|superseded`, `--repo` for `.deja/notes.jsonl`). | | `deja share ` | Export a redacted session digest for sharing. | | `deja sync export\|import\|ssh` | Watermarked, idempotent append-only history sync between machines. | | `deja repo candidates\|add` | Curate sanitized repository notes into `.deja/memory.jsonl`. | | `deja view` / `deja stats` | Generate a local standalone HTML explorer (`deja view`), audit history telemetry, or export profile heatmaps (`deja stats --card`, [PNG converter](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/card/)). | | `deja secrets [--scrub]` | Report or scrub secret matches in source transcripts. | | `deja rules [sync\|candidates]` | Sync standing rules from `~/.config/deja/rules.md` or inspect correction turns. | | `deja audit [--json]` | Inspect retention settings, purged sessions, recoverable spans, and hook/MCP wiring. | | `deja doctor [--deep]` / `deja mcp` | Verify store parity and run the stdio (`--http` for Streamable HTTP) MCP server. |
Reference: [CLI commands](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/commands.html) · [JSON schema](docs/json-output.md). ### MCP tools `deja mcp` exposes **one tool**, `deja`, multiplexed on `mode` (477 schema tokens/turn; legacy six-tool names remain accepted on `tools/call` for older configs). `deja mcp --context-search` serves a single `context_search` tool for Qwen Code's External Context MCP Profile v1 ([details](docs/registry/qwen.md)).
Tool schema and modes | Tool | Arguments | Returns | | --- | --- | --- | | `deja` | `mode`, `q`, `harness?`, `project?`, `limit?` | Mode-specific bounded payload below. | | Mode | `q` | Optional args | Returns | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `recall` | 1–3 exact terms (path, error, flag, symbol) | `harness?`, `limit?`, `offset?` | Compact snippets capped at 4 KB. | | `context` | 1–3 exact terms | `harness?` | Markdown session digest with modified code spans. | | `blame` | File path (optional `:line`) | `harness?`, `project?`, `since?`, `limit?`, `all?` | Sessions and decisions tied to the file. | | `fix` | Verbatim failing output | `limit?` | Prior successful commands after the same error. | | `how` | Command or tool name (e.g. `go test`) | `project?`, `limit?` | Observed invocations and flags here. | | `orient` | Empty or project topic | `project?`, `limit?` | Frequent project commands and active files. | | `remember` | Fact or decision | `project?`, `tags?` | Persists note locally, or into `.deja/memory.jsonl` with `repo:` / `repo:rejected` / `repo:gotcha`. | | `handoff` | Session id or harness name | `harness?` | Structured task packet to resume in another agent. |
## Supported harnesses All fifty supported coding agents share one index, CLI, and MCP server (`DEJA_*_ROOT` and upstream relocation env vars are honored; [session format registry](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/registry/README.html)). TRAE IDE transcripts live in an encrypted database, so `deja install trae-ide` wires MCP and skills (plus hooks under `trae-ide-auto` once enabled in IDE settings) without transcript ingestion. aider · Amp · Ante · Antigravity · Cherry Studio · Claude Code · Claw Code · Cline · CodeArts Desktop · CodeBuddy Code · CodeWhale · Codex CLI · Command Code · Continue · Copilot CLI · VS Code Copilot Chat · Crush · Cursor · DeepSeek Harness · Devin CLI · Gemini CLI · gajae-code · Goose · Grok Build · Hermes · JetBrains AI Assistant · Junie · Kilo Code · Kimchi Coding · Kimi Code · Kiro · MiniMax Code · MiMo-Code · Muse Code · Omnigent · omp (Oh My Pi) · OpenClaw · opencode · Orca · pi · prime-agent (PrimeIntellect) · Qoder · Qwen Code · Reasonix · Roo Code · Senpi · TRAE CLI · Windsurf / Devin Desktop · ZCode · Zed.

Ecosystem-native packages are also published and interoperate without duplicate registration: | Harness | Package | Install | | --- | --- | --- | | opencode | npm `opencode-deja` | `opencode plugin ([`antigravity-plugin/`](antigravity-plugin/)) | `agy plugin install deja-vu` | | Codex CLI | plugin `deja-vu` | `codex plugin marketplace add https://github.com/vshulcz/deja-vu` then `codex plugin add deja-vu@deja-vu` | | Grok Build | plugin `deja` | `grok plugin marketplace add vshulcz/deja-vu` then `grok plugin install deja` | | OpenClaw | ClawHub & npm `@vshulcz/openclaw-deja` | `openclaw plugins install clawhub:@vshulcz/openclaw-deja` | | pi (and omp) | npm `@vshulcz/pi-deja` | `pi install npm:@vshulcz/pi-deja` | | Hermes | memory provider `deja-memory` | `hermes plugins install vshulcz/deja-vu/extensions/hermes` | | Magpie | npm `@vshulcz/magpie-deja` | `magpie plugin add @vshulcz/magpie-deja` | | Orca | v2 `trusted-worker` plugin `deja` | `Orca → Plugins → extensions/orca` JetBrains IDEs | [JetBrains Marketplace](https://plugins.jetbrains.com/plugin/35998-deja-vu-cross-agent-ai-session-memory) | `idea installPlugins com.github.vshulcz.deja-vu` | | Neovim | `lazy.nvim` & CodeCompanion ([`extensions/nvim/`](extensions/nvim/)) | `{ "vshulcz/deja-vu", opts = {} }` | | tmux | TPM popup & status (`deja.tmux`) | `set -g @plugin 'vshulcz/deja-vu'` | | Raycast | Raycast https://github.com/vshulcz/deja-vu/releases/latest/download/deja-spec-kit.zip` | | CC Switch | 1-click import (`ccswitch://`) | [Add MCP to CC Switch](ccswitch://v1/import?resource=mcp&apps=claude,codex,gemini,opencode&config=eyJtY3BTZXJ2ZXJzIjp7ImRlamEiOnsiY29tbWFuZCI6Im5weCIsImFyZ3MiOlsiLXkiLCJAdnNodWxjei9kZWphLXZ1Iiwic2VydmUiXX19fQ==) | Standalone agent skills (`npx skills add https://github.com/vshulcz/deja-vu --skill deja-search`, `openclaw skills install @vshulcz/deja-search`, `hermes skills install vshulcz/deja-vu/skills/deja-search`) drive the installed `deja` binary.
## Semantic recall (optional) Point `deja embed` at a local Ollama, LM Studio, or OpenAI-compatible embeddings endpoint with `DEJA_EMBED_URL` to enable hybrid vector reranking on top of BM25. Without a configured or reachable endpoint, lexical retrieval and MCP recall operate normally.
Endpoint environment variables, instruction prefixes, and sidecar storage ```sh export DEJA_EMBED_URL='https://api.openai.com/v1/embeddings' export DEJA_EMBED_MODEL='text-embedding-3-small' export OPENAI_API_KEY='sk-...' deja embed ``` When `DEJA_EMBED_URL` is unset, `deja embed` probes `localhost:11434` and `localhost:1234` unless `DEJA_EMBED_OFF=1` or `DEJA_EMBED_URL=off`. Use `DEJA_EMBED_KEY` for custom authenticated endpoints (`OPENAI_API_KEY` is only sent to `https://api.openai.com`). Prefix models accept `DEJA_EMBED_QUERY_PREFIX` and `DEJA_EMBED_PASSAGE_PREFIX`. Vectors live beside `index.db` in `.vectors.bin`. Float32 vectors cost roughly 4 MB per 1k messages for a 1,024 dimension model. Redacted text only (truncated to ~2k chars) is sent during embedding.
## Benchmarks 88.9% hit@1 on the 470-question LongMemEval-S cleaned set (`88.2% hit@1`, `97.2% R@5` on all 500 questions), LoCoMo `71.9% hit@1`, `58%` token reduction on repeated repository tasks, and `0.7–0.8 ms` in-process lookups (`deja bench recall`). Reproducible drivers ship in the repository ([benchmarks guide](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/benchmarks.html)). ```sh deja bench recall # 100-query bilingual ranking regression gate deja bench context # 30 seeded task chains + negative controls deja bench block # compaction & session-start conclusion survival deja bench prompt # per-prompt trigger precision/false-positive suite deja bench ingest # incremental append, rewrite, and rename cost deja bench read # SQLite store parser scaling benchmark ```
Measurements and architectural comparison - **LongMemEval-S / LoCoMo:** Checked-in JSON artifacts under [`docs/benchmarks/`](docs/benchmarks/) record `88.9% hit@1` (470-question), `88.2% hit@1` / `97.2% R@5` (500-question), and LoCoMo `71.9% hit@1`. - **Task token cost (`Bench` A/B):** 53,558 vs 126,222 tokens without memory; 52,815 vs 103,443 in alternated 11-run trials (`58%` fewer tokens). - **Measured store latency (2,419–2,754 sessions, 179k–358k messages, 1.9–5.7 GB):** 0.7–0.8 ms median in-process lookup (`~15 ms` on LongMemEval-S haystacks), `~0.2–0.25 s` CLI end-to-end (including store freshness check), `~50 ms` no-op freshness check, `4%` index footprint (232 MB on 5.7 GB; 185 MB compressed on 19k sessions). | Model | History before install | Capture step | Runtime dependency | File recovery | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | **deja-vu** (transcript index) | Full existing stores across 50 harnesses | None | Single Go binary | `deja restore ` | | Record-forward MCP servers | Starts empty from install | Explicit writes / observer hooks | Background worker / LLM calls | No | | Raw transcript grep | Full logs | None | Manual search, high noise | No | Details in the [comparison methodology](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/compare.html).
## Configuration & FAQ
Configuration files under ~/.config/deja - `policy.json` (`DEJA_POLICY_FILE`): origin activation rules (`activations` for `search`/`mcp`/`auto` across `local`/`imported`/`repo`), `ignore` path globs, `auto_index`, `search_only`. - `exclude`: per-line project names, path patterns, or `harness:` stores to skip (`DEJA_EXCLUDE_PROJECTS`, `DEJA_EXCLUDE_HARNESSES`). - `projects`: ` = ` mappings unifying multiple worktrees under one project. - `rules.md`: standing instructions synced across installed agent rules files via `deja rules sync`. - Hook verbosity: `DEJA_RECALL=safe` (default, 2 KB / 3 sessions), `aggressive` (4 KB / 6 sessions), or `off`.
Multi-checkout projects & full uninstall Group checkouts in `~/.config/deja/projects` (`~/work/repo = work`) and run `deja index --rebuild`. To remove all state and hooks: ```sh deja uninstall --all rm -rf ~/.cache/deja ~/.local/share/deja ~/.config/deja ```
## Documentation - [Getting started](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/getting-started.html) · [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) · [CLI & configuration reference](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/commands.html) - [Compaction recovery](docs/compaction.md) · [Security model](docs/SECURITY-MODEL.md) · [Session format registry](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/registry/README.html) - [Where sessions are stored](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/where-sessions-are-stored.html) · [Benchmarks](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/benchmarks.html) ## Contributing & Support Run `make build test lint` before opening a pull request; see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) and [ROADMAP.md](ROADMAP.md). evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# DSH Workflow Canvas

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-workflow-canvas)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-workflow-canvas)
[![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-%3E%3D0.2.2-2f81f7)](https://github.com/Wasabi2575/dsh-workflow-canvas)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-3fb950.svg)](LICENSE)

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Orchestrate subagent workflows from the DSH sidebar. Draw each step as a node, wire
the data flow with three link types, enable it, and run it from chat — subagent nodes
are spawned for real, Lead nodes pause the run and are performed by the conversation
itself.

Describe a workflow in one sentence and the agent sketches the whole canvas for you;
tweak it in place afterwards with `canvas_patch`. Links make the flow obvious at a
glance — grey carries text, blue carries JSON, purple continues the upstream session.

![workflow canvas](docs/images/canvas-demo.png)

## Installation

Requires DeepSeek Harness **0.2.2** or newer (the package declares
`engines.dsh: ">=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0-0"`).

- **From the plugin market** — open **Plugins → Discover**, search
  *"workflow canvas"*, and install. The dshmarket entry is still awaiting
  review; see the
  [catalog PR](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin/pull/17180).
- **From npm** — install the published package `dsh-workflow-canvas` from the
  **Plugins** panel, or via the `plugin_manager` tool / `dsh` CLI with
  `install_bundle` and `target: dsh-workflow-canvas`.
- **From source** — clone the repository and install it as a local directory
  with **Plugins → Add plugin**, pointing at the checkout.

After installing, enable the plugin and the `workflow` tab appears in the right
sidebar.

## Quick start (30 seconds)

- **Zero-setup tryout**: open the right-sidebar `Workflow` tab → load a starter
  template from `☰ Presets` → press **● ON** at top-left → ask in chat to run the
  canvas.
- **Prompts you can copy right into chat**:
  - **Sketch from one sentence**: *"Build a parallel research workflow on the canvas: two subagents investigate competitors and technical feasibility in parallel, pause for me (Lead) to decide, then hand off to a writer subagent."*
  - **Patch in place**: *"Inspect the current canvas, turn Memory on for the feasibility node, and add a read-only cost-estimate node wired in parallel into plan synthesis."*
  - **Reuse a template with a new task**: *"Run the current canvas with the task: evaluate adding a local knowledge base to this project."*

## How this differs from other canvas plugins

DSH has more than one "workflow canvas". This one orchestrates **subagents** from
the sidebar, performs Lead steps in the conversation itself, and lets the agent
sketch a whole canvas from one sentence. For tool-call / condition / output
pipelines compiled to `ctx.workflows`, see
[`@piedpiper911/dsh-workflow-canvas`](https://github.com/PiedPiper911/dsh-workflow-canvas).

## Nodes

- **Subagent node** (green top bar) — spawns a child agent. Each node sets its own
  model, reasoning effort, capability scope (`standard` / `minimal`), fallback
  model, memory and role.
- **Lead node** (blue top bar) — performed by the conversation, never spawned. The
  entry Lead carries the overall task; the run stops at every Lead step and resumes
  with your answer.

## Links

| Type | Colour | Carries |
|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | grey | plain text |
| `structured` | blue | a JSON object; the upstream node is asked for structured output automatically |
| `session` | purple | the upstream child session, so the downstream runs **inside it** |

Drag from a right socket to a left socket, or from a left socket to a right one
(cycles are blocked immediately). Drag a connected left socket away to detach.

## Canvas controls & shortcuts

| Control / Shortcut | Action |
|---|---|
| `Shift+A` | Open the Add Node menu at the cursor (`1` / `2` to drop immediately) |
| Middle-drag / `Space` + left-drag | Pan the canvas (works even when starting over a node) |
| Wheel / `⊡ Fit` / `100%` | Cursor-anchored zoom / fit all nodes in view / reset to 100% on Lead |
| Marquee drag + `Ctrl+D` / `Delete` | Multi-select move, duplicate (preserving settings), or batch delete |
| `Ctrl+Z` / `Esc` | Undo structural edits / close open popups and menus |
| Right-drag across links | Cut swept links (toggle under `⋯`); `⋯` also has `⊞ Auto layout`, `⇧ Copy JSON`, and `Visual effects` (Minimal / Standard / Vivid) |

## Running

1. Write the task in the entry Lead, and a role for each node (or leave the task
   blank and pass `task` from chat when reusing a template).
2. Connect the nodes — unlinked nodes are dashed and skipped.
3. Press the **● ON / ○ OFF** pill at the top-left of the canvas, then ask in chat
   to run it (pass `reset: true` to restart from scratch).
4. The run proceeds in parallel waves (up to 4 at a time) and pauses at each Lead
   node with the results collected so far. Click a subagent's status pill (e.g.
   `Done ↗`) to jump straight to its live chat pane.

## Lead handover

When a `session` link points into a Lead node, the run reports that child session
id at the Lead step, so the conversation can keep talking to that agent instead of
only receiving its text.

## Inspecting, generating and editing the canvas from chat

- `canvas_inspect` — read the current canvas (enabled state, task, node ids/models/roles
  and links), so the agent can safely patch manually edited or preset graphs.
- `canvas_generate` — build a whole canvas from a node/edge sketch (replaces it).
- `canvas_patch` — edit it in place: update nodes by id, add or remove nodes and
  links, leaving positions and everything else untouched.

Generate and patch both write the canvas to the workspace, and the panel picks it
up within ~1.5s.

## Presets & sharing

`☰ Presets` ships with ready-to-run starter templates; name any canvas and press
`☆ Save` to keep your own. Presets live in browser storage; to share across
machines or between Desktop and `dsh web`, use `⋯ → ⇧ Copy JSON` and `⇩ Import`.

## Memory

A node with memory on reuses its child session: within a run, across runs in the
same session, and — through the persisted child id — after a restart, where the
Host cold-resumes it. A resume the Host refuses is forgotten and the node starts
fresh.

## Limits

- Saved presets live in browser storage and do not auto-sync between the Desktop
  app and `dsh web`, nor across machines (use `⋯ → ⇧ Copy JSON` and `⇩ Import`
  to move or share them).
- Node status is read from the subagent catalog, so Lead steps show **Runs in chat**
  instead of a tracked state.
- Up to 4 nodes run at a time.

## Making the agent use this plugin

The bundled guide ships as a skill named `workflow-canvas`. DSH has no "auto-load"
switch: the model sees each skill's **name and description** in its catalogue and
loads the body on demand. Three things make it reliable:

1. **A description that names the trigger words** — canvas, workflow, pipeline,
   node graph, 画布, 工作流, 编排.
2. **Pointers from the tools** — every `canvas_*` tool description tells the model
   to load the skill first, and tools are always in context.
3. **A line in your project's `AGENTS.md`** — the strongest option, because it is
   always loaded:

```markdown
When a task involves the workflow canvas or the canvas_* tools, call the `skill`
tool with name `workflow-canvas` first.
```

## Development

Edit `client.js` / `index.js` and reload the app; client changes hot-reload, Host
changes need a restart. Run `npm test` for the test suite. See
[docs/DETAIL.md](docs/DETAIL.md) for the internals.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

decision.reason: Static evidence chain reviewed. MIT, exact npm gitHead, DSH at least 0.2.2-rc.1 below 0.3.0 and committed native index/client agree. Session-bound commands/tools persist canvas state under DSH_PROFILE_DIR, validate DAG ordering and call the host subagent provider using the calling agent and abort signal. Reused child ids are keyed by session and node. No lifecycle hooks; external model cost and delegated actions remain runtime concerns. No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-qiniu-usage English | [中文](README.zh.md) A [DSH](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web GUI plugin for [Qiniu Cloud (七牛云)](https://www.qiniu.com/). It answers two questions without leaving the browser: - **How much did each model cost me today?** — per-model token usage (input / output / total), for one API key or the whole account, for today, yesterday or any past date. - **How much resource-pack quota is left this month?** — per-billing-item capacity / used / remaining, plus per-pack used amount and expiry date. It renders as a **「七牛云用量」 section in Settings** and as a **glance card below the left session list**. The plugin is **read-only against Qiniu** — it never creates, modifies or bills anything. The UI ships in Chinese and English and follows the host theme.

Settings → 七牛云用量 · credentials, key roster, auto-refresh

Details · model usage
date / key filters, per-model input / output / total 		 
Details · resource packs
month-to-date utilisation, per-pack detail

Sidebar glance card · one line collapsed, the three largest models plus Details / Refresh expanded
## Requirements | | | |---|---| | DSH | `>= 0.1.5-rc.1` (`dsh --version`), on a profile that boots the Web app — usually `web` | | Node | `^22.19.0 \|\| >=24.0.0` | | Qiniu | An **AccessKey / SecretKey** pair. A `sk-` token alone is not enough: the resource-pack (finance) API only accepts management credentials, and that AK needs billing/IAM financial permission. Without it the resource-pack cards show a targeted hint while the usage half keeps working. | ## Install The package is **not published to npm** — install it from a local checkout. `lib/` is gitignored, so build it first: ```bash cd /path/to/dsh-qiniu-usage npm install && npm run build dsh plugin --profile web add link:$PWD dsh web ``` Open **Settings → 七牛云用量**. That is the whole install. `dsh plugin` is a thin `pnpm` forwarder running inside the profile directory. It records the dependency in `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/package.json` and, because the package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, appends the package name to `dsh.profile.bundles` automatically — no manual patch-layer editing, and the web app is **not** rebuilt (the shell serves `exports["./client"]` at `/plugins//client.js`).
Other install sources, updating, uninstalling ```bash # copy instead of symlink (live edits no longer picked up) dsh plugin --profile web add file:/path/to/dsh-qiniu-usage # a packed tarball cd /path/to/dsh-qiniu-usage && npm run build && npm pack dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-qiniu-usage-.tgz # update cd /path/to/dsh-qiniu-usage && git pull && npm install && npm run build && dsh web # uninstall dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-qiniu-usage ``` A `git+…` install arrives **without `lib/`** and the package has no `prepare` script, so it will not load — build it yourself and `add link:$PWD` instead. To install without the CLI, add the dependency to `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/package.json` and append the package name (matching its `name` field, not the path or git URL) to `dsh.profile.bundles`, then run `dsh plugin --profile web install`. Uninstalling drops the dependency and the bundle entry, but credentials you saved through the GUI live in the DSH credential store and are **not** removed. Clear them in **Settings → 七牛云用量 → 凭据** first if you want them gone. With a `link:` install the profile keeps pointing at the same checkout. Restart `dsh web` after **host-half** changes; after **client-half** changes a rebuild plus a page refresh is enough.
## Configure ### Credentials The plugin reads credentials **by reference name** — a POSIX environment-variable name — never by value. Two ways to supply them: **A. Environment variables (read-only).** Export them in the environment that launches `dsh`: ```bash export QINIU_ACCESS_KEY=... export QINIU_SECRET_KEY=... dsh web ``` DSH does **not** read a `.env` file automatically — see [`.env.example`](./.env.example) for the variable names. Environment-backed entries can only be read, so the GUI form is greyed out and reports `来源：环境变量 QINIU_ACCESS_KEY · 只读`. **B. The GUI credential form.** In **Settings → 七牛云用量 → 凭据**, type the AK and SK and save; they land in the DSH credential store, and rotating a key takes effect on the next request — **no restart**. The form shows the *reference names* (read-only) above the *value* inputs, because that is the actual split: the config holds the name, the store holds the value. ### Settings | Setting | Default | Meaning | |---|---|---| | `enabled` | `true` | Master switch. When off, no routes are registered and no upstream request is ever made. | | `accessKeyRef` | `QINIU_ACCESS_KEY` | **Name** of the store entry holding the AccessKey | | `secretKeyRef` | `QINIU_SECRET_KEY` | Same, for the SecretKey | | `timezone` | `Asia/Shanghai` | Upstream accepts IANA names only (`Local` is rejected) | | `pollIntervalSec` | `5` | Client auto-refresh interval in seconds; `0` = manual refresh only | | `sidebarCard` | `true` | Show the glance card at the sidebar foot; off keeps the panel settings-only | Everything has a default, so an empty config is valid. The rest (`apiKeys[]`, `defaultDay`, `defaultKey`, the cache TTLs, the API base URLs) is documented in [`DESIGN.md`](./DESIGN.md) §10.1. Edit these through the profile's plugin config, like any other DSH plugin setting. `pollIntervalSec` and `sidebarCard` are picked up live; the rest apply on the next `dsh web` boot. ## Usage The settings page holds **configuration only** — the 凭据 form, a display-only key roster (**name / masked / today's status**, which doubles as "does this AK/SK work and which keys can it see"), and the auto-refresh interval. The **sidebar glance card** sits at the foot of the left column (it hides itself when the sidebar collapses to the 56px rail). Collapsed it is one line — icon, title, today's total; expanded it shows the three largest models plus a 「其余 N 个模型合计」 line, with **Details** and **Refresh** buttons. **Details** opens a centred dialog with two tabbed sections: - **Model usage** — date (today / yesterday) and key (all keys combined / a single key) filters plus the per-model input / output / total table. - **Resource packs** — month-to-date utilisation per billing item plus per-pack detail. Fully used packs (100%) are collapsed by default; one toggle at the bottom of the list expands them. The card title follows those filters: switch to yesterday and it reads 昨日用量, filter a key and it appends the key name — card and dialog share one store, so the number on the card can never mean something other than what it says. The expanded state is remembered per browser (`localStorage`, key `dsh-qiniu-usage:sidebar-card:expanded`). ## Security & privacy - **Credentials never reach the browser.** AK/SK exist only in the host process; the routes only ever return `{ configured, source, writable }`, a shape with no slot for a value. - **Loopback-fenced routes.** Every route checks the socket, host and origin, ignores `X-Forwarded-For`, and responds with `cache-control: no-store`. - **Redacted logs.** The AccessKey appears as its first four characters; the **SecretKey is never logged**. Credentials are written only through the DSH credential store, never to the plugin's own config file. ## Troubleshooting | Symptom | Cause / fix | |---|---| | The 「七牛云用量」 section does not appear | The bundle is not in `dsh.profile.bundles`. Check that `dsh plugin --profile web add …` succeeded, then restart `dsh web`. | | `Cannot find module …/lib/index.js` on boot | `lib/` was never built. Run `npm install && npm run build` in the checkout. | | `cannot get property "webServer" without inject` | Two copies of the plugin mounted at once. Keep a single entry in `dsh.profile.bundles`. | | Panel loads but every figure is an auth error | Credentials missing or wrong. Check the 凭据 card for `configured` / `source`. | | Resource-pack cards error, usage is fine | The AK lacks billing/IAM financial permission. | | Key list is empty | The roster could not be fetched: credentials missing or invalid, or the AK has no usage-query permission. | | No glance card in the sidebar | `sidebarCard` is `false`, or the sidebar is collapsed to the 56px rail. | | The Details dialog is covered by another overlay | The dialog uses `z-index: 60`; a host overlay above that covers it. | ## Known limitations - **Per-key filtering is unavailable for today.** Upstream has not attributed the current day's usage to individual keys yet and returns a single `api_key: "unknown"` aggregate group. The key roster therefore comes from a "last 30 days, up to yesterday" window, and selecting a key while viewing today says plainly that the figures are account-wide. Query **yesterday or earlier** for per-key numbers. - **Today's data is delayed.** The panel pins a standing warning and shows the data watermark. - **Zero-usage keys cannot be enumerated.** The upstream usage response only lists keys that had usage in the queried window. - **Lifetime vs month-to-date scope.** A pack's `used_amount` is lifetime cumulative while `month-overview`'s `month_used` is month-to-date; the panel labels both. - **The sidebar card depends on shell class names.** The plugin injects its container straight into the shell's `footArea` (substring-matched on `[class*=sidebarCol]` / `[class*=footArea]` / `[class*=settingsArea]`), because the foot's only extension seat (`sidebar.footer.action`) is a flex row that cannot host a block. If the shell renames those classes the card has no seat (no error; a body-level observer waits for one to appear). - **Not yet verified against a real account.** Every upstream fact in this plugin comes from documentation and fixtures. If something is off with real data, `scripts/smoke.mjs` is the tool that shows it. ## Development ```bash npm install npm run build # lib/index.js, lib/client.js, lib/types/** npm run check # tsc --noEmit npm test # vitest ``` The build emits two artifacts with different contracts, asserted by `scripts/build.mjs` before either is written: - `lib/index.js` — host half, self-contained ESM; the only import is `node:crypto`. - `lib/client.js` — browser half, a self-contained `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` bundle with `react` as the only external. `src/qiniu/respack.ts` looks pure but reaches `node:crypto` through `sign.ts`, so the client half may only take *values* from `react`, `src/client/**` and `src/qiniu/usage.ts` — one bad value import breaks the whole client bundle. Type-only imports are fine. `node scripts/preview.mjs` renders the panel to HTML (`--theme dark|light`, `?w=`), `node scripts/screenshots.mjs` regenerates the images in this README, and `node scripts/smoke.mjs` prints a normalised snapshot using AK/SK from the environment only. `smoke.mjs` is also the fastest way to verify upstream behaviour: with deliberately fake credentials it shows that the usage API reports authentication failure as **HTTP 200 + `{"status":false,"error":"UNAUTHENTICATED"}`** rather than a 401 — which is why the error classifier keys off the code text as well as the HTTP status. [`DESIGN.md`](./DESIGN.md) is the full design record — upstream API facts, signing traps, route contract, data model, caching, and a log of the real problems hit during implementation. Read it before contributing. ## License Apache-2.0. See [`LICENSE`](./LICENSE) and [`NOTICE`](./NOTICE) for attribution.

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
dsh-carry

电脑上的 DSH 会话，拿起手机接着用。

简体中文 · English

　　`dsh-carry` 是一个 DSH 插件，手机扫码配对后就能接着用电脑上的会话、审批工具请求、查看工作区文件和 HTML 预览。0.7.0 起支持局域网与公网双线路，一张二维码自动选入口，断线自动切换，不用重新扫码。 ## 📦 安装与首次连接 　　[GitHub Release v0.7.0](https://github.com/winlin926/dsh-carry/releases/tag/v0.7.0) 提供 `.tgz` 安装包；下面的 npm 命令暂时还是 0.6.5。 　　在要远程访问的电脑上装插件。**桌面版**：「插件 → 添加插件」搜 `@winlin926/dsh-carry`。**`dsh web`**： ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @winlin926/dsh-carry@latest ``` 1. 手机和电脑连同一个局域网。电脑上打开「远程控制」，开启连接。 2. 手机扫二维码，电脑核对设备、批准配对。 3. 打开一个已有会话就能用了。想收回权限，去电脑的已授权设备列表里删掉那台手机。
查看插件面板截图

## 📱 手机上能做什么
场景操作
离开工位，任务还在跑打开同一个会话，看回复、继续聊。
工具请求等你确认查看请求，批准或拒绝。
想看刚生成的文件点文件链接，直接预览。

工作区工具 · HTML 预览 · 设置
